summary.en: Kyoto's summers are intensely hot, similar to or exceeding Hong Kong's, requiring attendees of the Gion Matsuri to endure the midsummer sun. This month-long festival, held annually in July at Kyoto's Yasaka Shrine, is where participants pray for health and protection from illness, making it Japan's largest and most...
summary.zh: 京都的夏天酷热，与香港不相上下，甚至更甚，因此想要亲身体验一年一度的祇园祭的游客必须做好准备，迎接古都的盛夏烈日。这个为期一个月的日本著名夏日祭典于每年七月在京都的八坂神社举行。参与者在此祈求健康、驱除疾病，使其成为日本规模最大、最盛大的节日。祇园祭的亮点包括两次盛大的巡游：7月17日的“前祭”（Saki...

body.en: Kyoto summers are as hot as, if not hotter than, Hong Kong’s – so, anyone who wants to experience the annual Gion Matsuri first-hand must be prepared to face the midsummer sun of the ancient city. Gion Matsuri festival in Kyoto. Photo: Christian Kaden via Flickr/CC BY-NC-ND4.0. The famous month-long Japanese summer festival is held every July at Kyoto’s Yasaka Shrine. Attendees pray for health and to ward off sickness at what is probably Japan’s largest and most extravagant festival. Gion Matsuri highlights include two grand processions: the Saki Matsuri (Early Festival) on July 17 and the Ato Matsuri (Later Festival) on July 24. These highly decorative processions wind their way through Kyoto’s busiest streets. During this period, the city is filled with a festive atmosphere: colourful, noisy, and bustling. Visitors, both local and from afar, flock to the procession routes to take part in the celebrations. The streets are packed like sardines. To avoid the sweltering heat, I prefer sitting in my air-conditioned home in Hong Kong and watching the processions via YouTube livestreams. Yet, every time I watch the Gion Matsuri and see the excitement of the crowds, I find myself wondering why we cannot turn our own annual, month-long Yu Lan Festival into a city-wide celebration that is as central to Hong Kong’s cultural life as the Gion Matsuri is to Kyoto. Yu Lan, also known as the Hungry Ghost Festival, takes place on the 14th day of the seventh lunar month. In some places, it is observed on the 15th day instead. At its heart is the practice of offering food to spirits who have no family or friends to care for them and therefore receive no offerings. By feeding these lonely and hungry ghosts, communities receive blessings of peace and prosperity for the coming year. Hungry Ghost Festival in Central in 2025. Photo: Chloe Lai/HKFP. In contemporary terms, the festival is about caring for the weak and the marginalised, whether they are family members or not. Because of the nature of the festival, there is no central authority responsible for organising Yu Lan celebrations. Each event is organised by a local community. Preparations usually begin with the construction of a temporary bamboo theatre for Cantonese or Chiu Chow opera performances. During the celebration period, communities distribute “Peace Rice” or “Blessed Rice” to elderly residents and those in need, and hold auctions of auspicious items. The money raised will be reserved for the festival next year. The festivities end with the burning of the Ghost King, an oversized paper effigy, on the final evening of the celebration. Devotees build a 5-metre tall figure called “Dashiye” by bamboo and paper, representing “the king of ghosts” who...
body.zh: 京都的夏天与香港一样炎热，甚至更热——因此，任何想要亲身体验一年一度的祗园祭的人都必须做好面对这座古城仲夏阳光的准备。京都只园祭。照片：Christian Kaden，来自 Flickr/CC BY-NC-ND4.0。著名的为期一个月的日本夏日祭每年七月在京都八坂神社举行。参加者在这可能是日本最大、最奢华的节日中祈求健康、远离疾病。祗园祭的亮点包括两个盛大的游行：7 月 17 日的早祭和 7 月 24 日的阿东祭（晚祭）。这些装饰精美的游行队伍蜿蜒穿过京都最繁忙的街道。每逢这个时期，城市里都洋溢着节日的气氛：色彩缤纷、喧闹、热闹。本地和远方的游客纷纷涌向游行路线参加庆祝活动。街道上挤满了沙丁鱼。为了避开酷热，我更喜欢坐在香港有空调的家里，通过 YouTube 直播观看游行。然而，每次我观看祗园祭，看到人群的兴奋，我都会想，为什么我们不能将一年一度、为期一个月的盂兰节变成全城范围的庆祝活动，就像祗园祭之于京都一样，成为香港文化生活的核心。盂兰节，又名中元节，农历七月十四日。有的地方改为十五日。其核心是向没有家人或朋友照顾的灵魂提供食物，因此无法接受供奉。通过喂养这些孤独饥饿的鬼魂，社区将获得来年和平与繁荣的祝福。 2025 年中元节。照片：Chloe Lai/HKFP。用现代术语来说，这个节日是为了关爱弱者和边缘化群体，无论他们是否是家庭成员。由于节日的性质，没有中央机构负责组织盂兰盆节庆祝活动。每项活动均由当地社区组织。准备工作通常从建造临时竹剧场开始，以供粤剧或潮剧表演。节日期间，社区向老年居民和有需要的人分发“平安米”或“福米”，并举行吉祥物品拍卖会。筹集到的善款将预留给明年的音乐节。庆祝活动以在庆祝活动的最后一个晚上焚烧巨型纸制鬼王雕像而结束。信徒们用竹子和纸搭建了一个5米高的人物，称为“大石爷”，代表“鬼王”...

reflection.en: The comparison between Hong Kong's Hungry Ghost Festival and Kyoto's Gion Matsuri points to the incredible diversity and richness of human traditions. These festivals, with their unique customs and prayers for well-being, reflect a deep human longing for connection and meaning. Yahweh's creation is filled with such wonders, each culture a testament to the...
reflection.zh: 香港的盂兰节与京都的祇园祭的比较，彰显了人类文化传统的丰富多样性。这些节日以其独特的习俗和对健康的祈愿，反映了人类对联结和意义的深切渴望。雅伟的创造充满了这样的奇迹，每一种文化都证明了他所编织的精妙织锦。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: CE leads ceremony to mark victory over Japan in WWII
title.zh: 行政长官主持仪式纪念二战对日胜利

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee and other senior government officials attended a ceremony at City Hall's memorial garden on Thursday to mark the victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression. The event commenced at 8 am with the national anthem, flag-raising, a rifle salute, and two minutes of...
summary.zh: 行政长官李家超与多名政府高官周四早上在大会堂纪念花园出席仪式，纪念中国人民抗日战争胜利。仪式于早上八时开始，奏唱国歌、升国旗，并鸣枪致敬、默哀两分钟。随后，李家超带领各界代表向为国捐躯的先烈致敬。

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee and top government officials gathered at the memorial garden of City Hall on Thursday morning to commemorate victory in the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression. The ceremony began at 8 am with the playing of the national anthem and the raising of the national and SAR flags as the audience stood solemnly. A police rifle guard unit fired a salute, followed by two minutes of silence. Lee then led representatives from various sectors in bowing to pay tribute to the fallen heroes. Among those present were judicial officers, Executive Council and Legislative Council members, representatives of veterans' groups and district councils, as well as members of uniformed groups and youth organisations. Zhou Ji, director of the Beijing Liaison Office here also attended the ceremony. Edited by Robert Kemp
body.zh: 周四上午，行政长官李家超和政府高级官员齐聚市政厅纪念花园，纪念中国人民抗日战争胜利。仪式于上午8时开始，奏国歌，升国旗、特区旗，全场肃立。警察步枪警卫队鸣枪敬礼，随后默哀两分钟。随后，李光耀带领各界代表鞠躬，向逝去的英雄们致以崇高的敬意。出席者包括司法人员、行政会议和立法会议员、退伍军人团体和区议会的代表，以及制服团体和青年组织的成员。驻京联络处主任周济出席仪式。罗伯特·坎普编辑

reflection.en: Commemorations like this remind us of the immense sacrifices made in past conflicts. They also serve as a solemn occasion to reflect on the responsibilities of current leadership. May those in authority always remember their duty to govern justly and serve the people with integrity, honoring the past by building a better future.
reflection.zh: 这样的纪念活动提醒我们过去冲突中巨大的牺牲。它们也提供了一个庄严的时刻，让我们反思当前领导层的责任。愿掌权者永远牢记以公正治理、诚信服务人民的职责，通过建设更美好的未来来纪念过去。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Ex-Hong Kong care home warden found guilty of raping intellectually disabled female resident
title.zh: 香港一家养老院前主管强奸智障女住户罪名成立

summary.en: A former warden at a Hong Kong care home has been found guilty of raping an intellectually disabled female resident five times in 2024. A High Court jury delivered a majority verdict, convicting Chung Pui-kei of five counts of rape following deliberations.
summary.zh: 香港一家养老院的一名前主管因在2024年五次强奸一名智障女住户，已被高等法院陪审团裁定罪名成立。陪审团经过审议后，以多数票裁定钟沛基犯有五项强奸罪。

body.en: A former Hong Kong care home warden has been found guilty of raping an intellectually disabled female resident five times two years ago. The High Court. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. A High Court jury consisting of five men and two women on Wednesday found Chung Pui-kei , a former assistant warden at a Tai Po care home operated by the Hong Chi Association, guilty of five counts of rape, local media reported . Following roughly five hours of deliberation, the jury returned a 6:1 majority verdict for three charges and a unanimous decision on the remaining two, ruling Chung guilty of raping the resident on five occasions in July and August, 2024. Judge Douglas Yau adjourned sentencing until October 14, pending the defendant’s mitigation, his psychological and psychiatric assessments, and the victim’s psychological trauma report. 💡 If you are suffering from sexual or domestic violence, regardless of your age or gender, contact the police, Harmony House ( click for details ) and/or the Social Welfare Department on 28948896. Dial 999 in emergencies. The court previously heard that Chung, aged 38 at the time, started working at the Tai Po care home as an assistant warden about a month before the first offence took place on July 13, 2024. The victim, aged 22 at that time and identified in court only as X, has a mild intellectual disability, with an IQ equivalent to that of a nine-year-old child, the court heard. CCTV footage showed that Chung brought the victim into his office four times and entered her bedroom once, where police found his sperm on the woman’s bed sheet, the court heard. No ‘typical reaction’ The victim earlier testified via a video link, telling the court that she was “terrified” and felt pain during the sexual assaults, and that she had tried to say “no” but was told by the defendant to keep quiet. Chung denied the sexual assaults during his testimony, saying he merely chatted with the woman and gave her food in his office. He also denied ejaculating in the woman’s bedroom, claiming instead that he wore a pair of shorts on that day and “sweated a lot.” Hong Chi Pinehill Integrated Vocational Training Centre. Photo: Hong Chi Association, via Facebook. Before the jury retired to consider their verdict on Wednesday, Judge Yau reminded the jurors not to assume that sexual assault victims always respond by promptly reporting the attack to police. “Victims don’t necessarily have a typical reaction,” the judge said in Cantonese, adding that some may feel ashamed or scared and delay filing an official report. The Hong Chi Association, Hong Kong’s largest NGO for people with intellectual disabilities, fired Chung following the incident and appointed an independent review committee to examine protective measures in...
body.zh: 一名前香港疗养院舍监因两年前强奸一名智障女住客五次而被判有罪。高等法院。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。据当地媒体报道，由五男两女组成的高等法院陪审团周三裁定匡智会经营的大埔疗养院前助理院长钟佩琪犯有五项强奸罪。经过大约五个小时的审议，陪审团以 6:1 的多数票对三项指控做出了裁决，并对其余两项做出了一致决定，裁定钟犯有 2024 年 7 月和 8 月五次强奸该居民的罪行。丘道格拉斯·尤 (Douglas Yau) 法官将宣判推迟至 10 月 14 日，等待被告的减刑、心理和精神评估以及受害者的心理创伤报告。 💡 如果您遭受性暴力或家庭暴力，无论您的年龄或性别，请与警方、和谐之家（点击查看详情）和/或社会福利署联系：28948896。紧急情况请拨打999。法庭此前获悉，钟当时年38岁，在2024年7月13日第一次犯罪发生前约一个月，开始在大埔护老院担任助理院长。案情显示，受害人当时22岁，在法庭上仅称X，有轻度智力障碍，智商相当于9岁儿童。法庭获悉，闭路电视录像显示，钟四次带受害人进入他的办公室，一次进入她的卧室，警方在该女子的床单上发现了他的精子。没有“典型反应” 受害者早些时候通过视频链接作证，告诉法庭，她在性侵犯期间感到“害怕”并感到疼痛，她试图说“不”，但被告告诉她保持安静。钟在作证时否认性侵犯，称他只是在办公室与该女子聊天并给她食物。他还否认在该女子的卧室里射精，并声称那天他穿着一条短裤，并且“出了不少汗”。匡智松岭综合职业训练中心。照片：匡智会，来自 Facebook。在陪审团于周三休庭审议裁决之前，丘法官提醒陪审员不要认为性侵犯受害者总是会立即向警方报告袭击事件。 “受害者不一定有典型的反应，”法官用粤语说，并补充说，有些人可能会感到羞耻或害怕，从而推迟提交正式报告。香港最大的智障人士非政府组织匡智会在事件发生后解雇了钟先生，并任命了一个独立审查委员会来审查...

reflection.en: This verdict brings a measure of justice for a vulnerable resident who was unable to speak for herself. It underscores the importance of speaking up for those who cannot, and ensuring that even the most marginalized are protected and heard when their rights are violated.
reflection.zh: 这项判决为一名无法为自己发声的弱势住户带来了一定的公正。它强调了为那些不能发声的人挺身而出、确保即使是最边缘化的人在权利受到侵犯时也能得到保护和倾听的重要性。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Saleswoman arrested over improper sales practices
title.zh: 女售货员因不当销售行为被捕

summary.en: Customs officers arrested a 22-year-old saleswoman on suspicion of unfair trade practices. This action is part of a follow-up operation against a beauty company accused of aggressive sales tactics for skincare products and beauty devices. The saleswoman allegedly used undue influence at the company's Sha Tin branch,...
summary.zh: 海关官员周三宣布，逮捕了一名22岁的女售货员，怀疑她有不公平交易行为。这是海关部门针对一家美容公司涉嫌在销售护肤品和美容仪器时采取激进商业行为的后续行动。据称，该女子在公司沙田分店销售美容产品时施加不当影响并进行不当商业行为，导致一名顾客进行了购买。

body.en: Customs on Wednesday announced that its officers have arrested a 22-year-old female saleswoman over suspicion of unfair trade practices. This came as the department conducted a follow-up operation against a beauty company suspected of engaging in aggressive commercial practices in the sale of skincare products and beauty devices. Following the arrest of a financial manager and an administrative manager of the company, Senior Investigation Officer Leung Ka-ho said the arrestee is a frontline saleswoman. “[The woman] allegedly exerted undue influence and conducted improper commercial conduct while selling beauty products at the company’s Sha Tin branch, causing a customer to make a purchase that would not have occurred otherwise,” he said. “Therefore, customs carried out this operation. I stress that the investigation is still ongoing, and more arrests could be made.” Leung said the department has received 38 reports against the beauty company so far, involving a total of HK$3 million. Officers would continue to follow up on the reports, he said. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 海关周三宣布，其官员因涉嫌不公平贸易行为而逮捕了一名 22 岁女售货员。此前，该部门对一家涉嫌在销售护肤品和美容仪器方面采取激进商业行为的美容公司进行了后续行动。该公司一名财务经理及一名行政经理被捕后，高级调查员梁家豪表示，被捕者是一名前线销售员。 “（该女子）涉嫌在该公司沙田分店销售美容产品时施加不当影响并进行不当商业行为，导致顾客进行原本不会发生的购买，”他说。 “因此，海关进行了这次行动。我强调，调查仍在进行中，可能会逮捕更多人。”梁振英表示，海关至今已接获38宗针对该美容公司的举报，涉案金额达300万港元。他表示，警方将继续跟进报道。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: The news of a saleswoman's arrest for alleged improper practices serves as a stark reminder of the importance of integrity in commerce. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly,' a principle that extends to every transaction, ensuring fairness and honesty in our dealings with others. May we all strive to conduct our work with ethical diligence, reflecting Yahweh's...
reflection.zh: 一名女售货员因涉嫌不当销售行为被捕的消息，警示我们商业诚信的重要性。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们“秉公行义”，这一原则适用于每一次交易，确保我们在与他人交往时公平诚实。愿我们都在商业活动中努力秉持道德操守，反映雅伟的品格。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Man, woman arrested as DH seizes unregistered jabs
title.zh: 卫生署检获未注册针剂拘捕一男一女

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities have seized approximately 50 suspected unregistered injections from over 13 locations and arrested a man and a woman. The operation targeted the use of a WT1 vaccine advertised for cancer prevention, though the Assistant Director of Health stated that the seized items were mostly healthcare...
summary.zh: 香港当局在超过13个地点检获约50支疑似未注册的针剂，并拘捕了一男一女。此次行动针对一种宣传能预防多种癌症的WT1疫苗的使用，但卫生署助理署长表示，检获的物品主要是维生素等保健产品，而WT1疫苗仍在调查中。

body.en: Authorities have seized some 50 suspected unregistered injections from over 13 premises and arrested two people in a recent operation. They arrested a 28-year-old man and a woman. The operation was carried out jointly by the Department of Health and police, to crack down on the usage of the Wilms' tumor 1 (WT1) vaccine, which is advertised as being able to prevent multiple cancers. But Assistant Director of Health Frank Chan on Wednesday said authorities have so far not found any of the vaccines in the operation. “The over 50 suspected unregistered injections we found are mostly healthcare products like vitamins,” he said. “As for the WT1 vaccine, we are still carrying out an investigation. “So far, we have no report of adverse reactions to the vaccine. But we still hope to find the product in the investigation so that we can hold those responsible accountable.” Chan also said the seized injections belong to Part 1 poisons, adding relevant companies and those in charge are suspected of the illegal sale and possession of unregistered pharmaceutical products. He said the operation is still ongoing and more arrests could be made. _____________________________ Last updated: 2026-09-02 HKT 22:44 Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 当局在最近的一次行动中，从超过 13 个场所查获了约 50 支疑似未经登记的注射剂，并逮捕了两人。他们逮捕了一名 28 岁的男子和一名女子。此次行动由卫生部和警方联合开展，旨在打击使用被宣传为能够预防多种癌症的维尔姆斯肿瘤1号（WT1）疫苗。但卫生部助理总监 Frank Chan 周三表示，迄今为止，当局尚未在行动中发现任何疫苗。 “我们发现的50多个疑似未注册注射剂大多是维生素等保健品，”他说。 “至于WT1疫苗，我们还在进行调查。”到目前为止，我们还没有收到疫苗不良反应的报告。但我们还是希望能在调查中找到该产品，以便追究相关责任人的责任。”陈又表示，检获的注射剂属于第1部毒药，相关公司及负责人涉嫌非法售卖及管有未经注册药剂制品。他表示，行动仍在进行中，可能会逮捕更多人。 _____________________________ 最后更新：2026-09-02 香港时间 22:44 编辑：谭咏麟

reflection.en: In Hong Kong, authorities are investigating unregistered injections and a specific vaccine, arresting two individuals in the process. This action underscores the importance of integrity and accountability in public health, ensuring that treatments are safe and properly regulated. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God....
reflection.zh: 在香港，当局正在调查未注册的针剂和一种特定疫苗，并在此过程中逮捕了两人。这一行动凸显了公共卫生领域诚信和问责制的重要性，确保治疗方法安全且得到妥善监管。 弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、谦卑与神同行。这一原则指导掌权者维护保护市民的标准，同时也提醒我们，真正的公义在所有事业中都包含慈爱和道德行为，包括医疗保健领域。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.
reflection.zh: Shein在香港股市上市首日估值从近1000亿美元暴跌至略高于260亿美元，这有力地提醒我们商业的波动性。箴言16:3鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划，这智慧超越了市场的起伏。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 希恩（Shein）让伦敦股市躲过一劫 | 尼尔斯·普拉特利

summary.en: China's fashion giant Shein will list in Hong Kong with a reduced valuation, accompanied by significant questions surrounding its business practices. The article speculates on a parallel reality where Shein might have pursued a listing on the London Stock Exchange, a move that was actively courted by politicians...
summary.zh: 中国的时尚巨头希恩（Shein）将以缩水的估值在香港上市，其商业模式引发了重大疑问。文章设想了另一种可能，即希恩本可能在伦敦证券交易所上市，而英国政界曾积极争取，希望借此提振当地的上市市场并展现对国际资本的开放态度。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大疑问在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。 2024 年和去年，随着两个主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news about Shein's Hong Kong listing, with its "shrunken price tag" and "big questions over its business model," highlights the ongoing tension between commerce and ethics. Micah 6:8 calls us to "act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God." This ancient wisdom challenges us to consider the ethical foundations of global business,...
reflection.zh: 关于希恩（Shein）在香港上市的新闻，伴随着其“缩水的估值”和“商业模式的重大疑问”，凸显了商业与道德之间持续存在的张力。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的雅伟同行”。这古老的智慧促使我们反思全球商业的道德基础，并敦促我们在所有交易中走上正直和公平的道路。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Pacific islands to face food shortages due to global warming: Scientists
title.zh: 科学家：全球变暖将导致太平洋岛屿粮食短缺

summary.en: Scientists have warned that Pacific islands will face food shortages and compromised drinking water due to rising sea levels. This warning comes as a UN report indicates the world is projected to exceed the 1.5°C global warming limit set by the Paris Agreement, with temperatures potentially peaking at 1.8°C.
summary.zh: 科学家警告称，由于海平面上升，太平洋岛屿将面临粮食短缺和饮用水问题。此前联合国的一份报告指出，全球气温预计将超过《巴黎协定》设定的1.5摄氏度升温上限，最高可能达到1.8摄氏度。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The Pacific islands will face food shortages, and drinking water will be affected by rising seas, scientists said Wednesday, as a U.N. report found the world would fail to limit global warming to 1.5°C.

A U.N. Environment Programme (UNEP) report projected global temperature rise will peak at 1.8°C above preindustrial levels, overshooting a goal of limiting warming to 1.5°C set by the Paris Agreement.

Scientists told a summit of Pacific leaders in Palau that the impact of "overshooting" that target will be a $90 million loss in fishing license fees, or 13% of government revenue in the region, causing an "economic crisis."

Tuna will migrate east, away from island states where a third of the world's tuna is caught, said Andrew Jones, deputy director general of The Pacific Community.

Coastal fishers who feed island people will lose 65% of their catch, he told reporters Wednesday.

"That's about two meals per family per week that are not on the plate—clean, free, healthy protein that will need to be replaced," he said.

Devastating floods will increase, and salt water will inundate drinking water, reducing the ability to live on islands, he said.

Maina Talia, climate change minister for low-lying Tuvalu, said the science showed the climate crisis "is real now, it is here now."

Pacific islands are seeking financial help for climate change adaptation and tougher action by developed countries to curb the use of fossil fuels.

"We are fighting against a very strong current that is sweeping us into very dangerous waters, and we have to do everything in our power to fight our way back to 1.5," said Marshall Islands climate envoy Tina Stege.

Vanuatu climate change minister Ralph Regenvanu urged countries such as Australia, the largest member of the Pacific regional bloc and a major exporter of coal and gas, to stop expanding their fossil fuel exports.

"Australia is not doing enough. Australia is a major producer of fossil fuels, we all know fossil fuels are the primary driver of the crisis," he told reporters.

Australia's Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said his country's energy transition "can't happen overnight," adding gas had a role to play in the transition to renewables.

Master's in physics with research experience. Long-time science news enthusiast. Plays key role in Science X's editorial success. Full profile →
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 科学家周三表示，太平洋岛屿将面临粮食短缺，饮用水将受到海平面上升的影响，因为联合国报告发现世界无法将全球变暖限制在 1.5°C 之内。 联合国环境规划署 (UNEP) 的一份报告预计，全球气温上升峰值将比工业化前水平高出 1.8°C，超出《巴黎协定》设定的将升温限制在 1.5°C 的目标。 科学家们在帕劳举行的太平洋领导人峰会上表示，“超出”这一目标的影响将是捕鱼许可费损失 9000 万美元，即该地区政府收入的 13%，从而引发“经济危机”。 太平洋共同体副总干事安德鲁·琼斯表示，金枪鱼将向东迁移，远离岛国，那里捕获了世界上三分之一的金枪鱼。 他周三告诉记者，为岛上居民提供食物的沿海渔民将损失 65% 的渔获量。 “这大约意味着每个家庭每周有两顿饭没有出现在盘子里——需要更换干净、免费、健康的蛋白质，”他说。 他说，毁灭性的洪水将会增加，咸水将淹没饮用水，降低岛屿上的生存能力。 地势低洼的图瓦卢气候变化部长马伊纳·塔利亚表示，科学表明气候危机“现在是真实存在的，现在就在这里”。 太平洋岛屿正在寻求财政帮助来适应气候变化，并寻求发达国家采取更严厉的行动来限制化石燃料的使用。 马绍尔群岛气候特使蒂娜·斯泰格表示：“我们正在与一股非常强劲的洋流作斗争，它将把我们卷入非常危险的水域，我们必须尽我们所能，努力回到1.5。” 瓦努阿图气候变化部长拉尔夫·雷根瓦努敦促太平洋区域集团最大成员和煤炭和天然气主要出口国澳大利亚等国家停止扩大化石燃料出口。 “澳大利亚做得还不够。澳大利亚是化石燃料的主要生产国，我们都知道化石燃料是危机的主要驱动因素，”他告诉记者。 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞表示，澳大利亚的能源转型“不可能一蹴而就”，并补充说天然气在向可再生能源转型中可以发挥作用。 物理学硕士，具有研究经验。长期科学新闻爱好者。在 Science X 的编辑成功中发挥着关键作用。完整档案 →

reflection.en: The news from the Pacific islands is stark: rising seas threaten their food and water. This reality underscores the profound interconnectedness of our world and the consequences of environmental neglect. As stewards of creation, we are called to recognize that the Earth and all its fullness belong to Yahweh, and to act with wisdom and care for the...
reflection.zh: 来自太平洋岛屿的消息令人警醒：海平面上升威胁着他们的食物和水源。这一现实凸显了我们世界深刻的相互联系以及环境被忽视的后果。作为受造界的管家，我们被呼召认识到大地及其万有都属于雅伟，并以智慧和关爱去对待那些脆弱的生命。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Five-metal 2D catalysts could convert CO₂ to CO without needing an extra electrical boost
title.zh: 五金属二维催化剂可将二氧化碳转化为一氧化碳，无需额外的电力助推

summary.en: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) is primarily viewed as a pollutant that needs removal from the atmosphere due to activities like burning fossil fuels. However, researchers are exploring the possibility of transforming CO₂ into a valuable industrial resource, potentially creating a circular economy approach to climate change...
summary.zh: 二氧化碳（CO₂）通常被视为需要从大气中清除的污染物，这主要是由于燃烧化石燃料等活动所致。然而，研究人员正在探索将CO₂转化为有价值的工业资源的可能，从而为减缓气候变化创造一种循环经济的方法。

body.en: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) is usually discussed as something the world needs to get rid of. Activities such as the burning of fossil fuels for daily use, including electricity and transportation, and industrial applications release significant amounts of CO₂, and the gas enters the atmosphere. Researchers are now asking whether this road could have a roundabout. What if CO₂, which is at the center of the climate crisis, could be turned into something useful and put back into the industrial cycle?
body.zh: 二氧化碳 (CO2) 通常被认为是世界需要消除的物质。日常使用的化石燃料燃烧（包括电力和运输）以及工业应用等活动会释放大量二氧化碳，这些气体会进入大气中。研究人员现在正在询问这条路是否可以有一个环形交叉路口。如果二氧化碳（气候危机的核心）可以转化为有用的东西并重新投入工业循环，会怎样？

reflection.en: The pursuit of turning a problematic substance like CO₂ into something useful reflects a deep human impulse to understand and work with creation. It echoes the ancient wisdom found in observing the natural world, as Job 12:7-9 suggests, where even the beasts and birds can teach us about the Creator's design and purpose.
reflection.zh: 将二氧化碳这种有害物质转化为有用之物的追求，体现了人类深刻理解和利用造物的冲动。这呼应了《约伯记》12:7-9 中所揭示的、从观察自然世界中汲取智慧的古老智慧，其中甚至走兽飞鸟都能教导我们关于创造者的设计和目的。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Cellular maintenance crew may miss as much as half of certain misfolded proteins
title.zh: 细胞维护团队可能会错过多达一半的某些错误折叠蛋白

summary.en: As proteins are synthesized within a cell, they must fold into a specific three-dimensional structure to function correctly. However, this folding process can sometimes go awry, resulting in misfolded proteins that lose their functionality. Typically, these misfolded proteins are identified by the cell's quality...
summary.zh: 在细胞内合成蛋白质时，它们必须折叠成特定的三维结构才能正常工作。然而，这个折叠过程有时会出错，导致错误折叠的蛋白质失去功能。通常，这些错误折叠的蛋白质会被细胞的质量控制系统识别，该系统会尝试修复它们或将其分解以回收利用。宾夕法尼亚州立大学的一项新研究发现，具有特定结构特征的蛋白质更容易发生错误折叠，并可能逃避这些细胞维...

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

As proteins are made in a cell, they are folded into the 3D structure that allows them to work, but sometimes this process can go wrong. When it does, the misfolded proteins lose some or all of their function and usually get tagged by the cell's quality assurance and maintenance crews, which try to repair the proteins or, if they can't, strip them to recycle their parts.

A new study led by scientists at Penn State revealed that proteins containing a certain type of structure are more likely to misfold and be targeted for removal, yet nearly half still manage to evade the cellular maintenance crew. The misfolded proteins that persist could accumulate in cells, disrupting the balance of protein production and recycling and potentially contributing to aging and disease, according to the researchers. The study was recently published in Nature Communications .

"Like a tiny factory, cells make proteins," said Ed O'Brien, professor of chemistry in the Penn State Eberly College of Science and the leader of the research team. "And like a factory, cells have quality control mechanisms to catch any errors on the production line. We've recently identified a new class of protein misfolding, and we were interested in whether it had any impact on how the cellular quality control system maintains a balance of protein production, repair and recycling—protein homeostasis.

"Additionally, protein misfolding is known to contribute to diseases like Alzheimer's and Huntington's. Therefore, increasing our understanding of the basic biology underlying this novel class of misfolding could lead to the identification of new disease origins and treatments."

The new class of misfolding occurs through a change in the entanglement of a segment of the protein. The string of amino acids that make proteins can form a loop, and the end of the string can thread through the loop, forming a knot-like structure. Misfolding can occur either by this type of entanglement forming where it shouldn't or by failing to form when it is part of a protein's natural structure.

"We focused on proteins that have an entanglement as part of their native structure because we have shown in the past that they are more likely to misfold," said Yang Jiang, associate research professor of chemistry at Penn State and first author of the paper. "We used an existing database of proteins that have been tagged with a marker for degradation in human fibroblast cells and cross-referenced it with a database of protein structures so we could see the proportion of proteins with the entanglement that were marked by the cellular quality...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 当蛋白质在细胞中产生时，它们会折叠成允许它们发挥作用的 3D 结构，但有时这个过程可能会出错。当这种情况发生时，错误折叠的蛋白质会失去部分或全部功能，通常会被细胞的质量保证和维护人员标记，他们会尝试修复蛋白质，如果不能，则将其剥离以回收其部件。 宾夕法尼亚州立大学科学家领导的一项新研究表明，含有某种类型结构的蛋白质更有可能错误折叠并成为去除的目标，但仍有近一半的蛋白质仍设法逃避细胞维护人员的追捕。研究人员表示，持续存在的错误折叠蛋白质可能会在细胞中积聚，破坏蛋白质生产和回收的平衡，并可能导致衰老和疾病。该研究最近发表在《自然通讯》杂志上。 “就像一个小工厂，细胞制造蛋白质，”宾夕法尼亚州立大学埃伯利理学院的化学教授、研究小组的负责人埃德·奥布莱恩说。 “就像工厂一样，细胞有质量控制机制来捕捉生产线上的任何错误。我们最近发现了一类新的蛋白质错误折叠，我们感兴趣的是它是否对细胞质量控制系统如何维持蛋白质生产、修复和回收的平衡——蛋白质稳态——产生任何影响。 “此外，已知蛋白质错误折叠会导致阿尔茨海默氏症和亨廷顿舞蹈症等疾病。因此，增加我们对这类新型错误折叠背后的基础生物学的理解可能有助于识别新的疾病起源和治疗方法。” 新一类错误折叠是通过蛋白质片段缠结的变化而发生的。制造蛋白质的氨基酸串可以形成一个环，而该串的末端可以穿过该环，形成一个结状结构。错误折叠可能是由于这种类型的缠结在不应该形成的地方形成，或者是由于作为蛋白质天然结构的一部分而未能形成。 宾夕法尼亚州立大学化学副研究教授、该论文的第一作者杨江说：“我们专注于天然结构中具有缠结的蛋白质，因为我们过去已经证明它们更有可能错误折叠。” “我们使用了现有的蛋白质数据库，这些蛋白质已标记有人类成纤维细胞降解标记，并将其与蛋白质结构数据库进行交叉引用，这样我们就可以看到以细胞质量为标记的具有缠结的蛋白质的比例......

reflection.en: The intricate world within our cells, where proteins must fold just right to function, is a testament to the complexity of creation. Even with sophisticated cellular 'maintenance crews,' errors occur, and some misfolded proteins go undetected. This reminds us that even in the most finely tuned systems, perfection is elusive, and there is much to learn from...
reflection.zh: 我们细胞内复杂的世界，蛋白质必须恰当折叠才能发挥作用，这证明了造物的精妙。即使有精密的细胞“维护团队”，错误仍会发生，一些错误折叠的蛋白质会逃脱检测。这提醒我们，即使在最精密的系统中，完美也难以企及，而从观察自然世界的运作和局限性中，我们可以学到很多。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Caterpillar twitches in an ultraquiet chamber help biologists understand how these insects hear without ears
title.zh: 毛毛虫在超静音室中的抽搐帮助生物学家了解它们如何在没有耳朵的情况下听到声音

summary.en: Biologists are studying the subtle twitches of tobacco hornworm caterpillars in an ultra-quiet chamber to understand how they detect predators like wasps, despite lacking visible ears. This research aims to uncover the mechanisms behind their sensory perception.
summary.zh: 生物学家正在超静音室中研究烟草天蛾毛毛虫的细微抽搐，以了解它们如何在没有可见耳朵的情况下探测到黄蜂等捕食者。这项研究旨在揭示其感官感知的机制。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

In a quiet summer garden, a caterpillar perches on a branch, munching serenely on leaves. A moment later, it freezes. It senses danger—and just in time. From behind, a wasp approaches, sizing up its prey.

Tobacco hornworm caterpillars don't look like they have ears, and yet they're able to sense predators such as wasps. How does the caterpillar know a wasp is approaching?

Scientists do not yet fully understand how this caterpillar's senses work, but we are part of a team of biologists and engineers who want to figure it out. Our ongoing research suggests the tobacco hornworms can hear using tiny, supersensitive hairs on their bodies.

Understanding the intricate biological mechanisms that allow this organism to perceive and interact with its environment would help solve a mystery of the natural world. It could also help scientists design new, cheaper microphone technology.

Because the hornworms' hairs are so sensitive, we have to study them in complete silence. And where better to study hearing than in the complete silence of an anechoic chamber ?

What happens outside the anechoic chamber stays outside the anechoic chamber because it is meticulously built that way. Anechoic chambers are some of the quietest places in the world. They are engineered specifically to block the entry of any undesired sounds. Heavy-duty steel springs support the "floating" chamber and keep it from touching the ground. This detachment isolates the space from outside vibrations or noise.

In such a chamber, we studied the caterpillars' responses to vibrations. Every day for a year, we set up a caterpillar on a platform and sent vibrations toward the platform at a variety of intensities.

To measure the movement and precise vibrations traveling through the platform on which the caterpillar sat, we used a device called an accelerometer. In response to vibrations, we sometimes saw the caterpillars jump; at other times, they twitched or even shuddered from the sheer physical force.

Through our observations, we pinned down the specific threshold at which the caterpillars stopped reacting to vibrations. Any vibration weaker than that magnitude, and the caterpillar wouldn't visibly react at all.

After noticing this consistent pattern, we decided to test more caterpillars inside the anechoic chamber, but this time using airborne sound as the stimulus. The idea was that if the caterpillars are more sensitive to sound than they are to vibrations, they are probably hearing airborne sounds independent of any vibrations.

Sound is broadly defined as a form of vibration or energy that becomes audible,...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 在一个安静的夏日花园里，一只毛毛虫栖息在树枝上，安静地咀嚼着树叶。过了一会儿，它就冻结了。它及时感知到危险。一只黄蜂从后面靠近，打量着猎物。 烟草天蛾毛毛虫看起来没有耳朵，但它们能够感知黄蜂等捕食者。毛毛虫如何知道黄蜂正在接近？ 科学家们尚未完全了解这种毛毛虫的感官是如何工作的，但我们是一个由生物学家和工程师组成的团队的一员，他们希望弄清楚这一点。我们正在进行的研究表明，烟草天蛾可以利用它们身体上微小的、超敏感的毛发来听到声音。 了解这种生物体感知环境并与其相互作用的复杂生物机制将有助于解开自然世界的谜团。它还可以帮助科学家设计新的、更便宜的麦克风技术。 由于天角虫的毛发非常敏感，我们必须完全安静地研究它们。还有哪里比在完全安静的消声室中更好地研究听力呢？ 电波暗室之外发生的事情都留在电波暗室之外，因为它是按照这种方式精心构建的。消声室是世界上最安静的地方之一。它们经过专门设计，可以阻止任何不需要的声音进入。重型钢弹簧支撑“浮动”室并防止其接触地面。这种分离将空间与外界振动或噪音隔离。 在这样的房间里，我们研究了毛毛虫对振动的反应。在一年的时间里，我们每天都在平台上放置一条毛毛虫，并向平台发送不同强度的振动。 为了测量毛毛虫所在平台的运动和精确振动，我们使用了一种称为加速度计的设备。为了响应振动，我们有时会看到毛毛虫跳跃；有时，他们会因为巨大的体力而抽搐，甚至颤抖。 通过观察，我们确定了毛毛虫停止对振动做出反应的特定阈值。任何比这个幅度弱的振动，毛毛虫根本不会做出明显的反应。 注意到这种一致的模式后，我们决定在消声室内测试更多毛毛虫，但这次使用空气传播的声音作为刺激。这个想法是，如果毛毛虫对声音比对振动更敏感，那么它们可能会听到与任何振动无关的空气传播的声音。 声音被广泛地定义为一种可听见的振动或能量形式，...

reflection.en: The intricate design of a caterpillar, which can sense danger without ears, points to the profound wisdom embedded in Yahweh's creation. As Job 12:7-9 reminds us, 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you... In all these the hand of Yahweh has done this.' Observing such marvels invites us to deeper contemplation...
reflection.zh: 毛毛虫在没有耳朵的情况下就能感知危险的复杂设计，这指向了雅伟创造物中蕴含的深刻智慧。正如约伯书12:7-9所提醒的：“你可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们会告诉你……这一切都是雅伟的手所做的。”观察这样的奇迹，邀请我们更深入地思考创造者的艺术。

title.en: Trees use a 'muscle' to correct their posture—a newly discovered role for tension wood
title.zh: 树木使用“肌肉”纠正姿势——张力木的新作用

summary.en: Researchers have discovered that trees can correct stem curvature using a biological process involving tension wood, which acts like a muscle to realign the stem. This was observed in young trees with bent stems that were isolated from light and gravity cues, relying solely on their own curvature perception.
summary.zh: 研究人员发现，树木可以通过一种涉及张力木的生物过程来纠正茎的弯曲，张力木的作用类似于肌肉，可以使茎重新对齐。这一现象在茎部弯曲的幼树上得到观察，这些树被隔离了光和重力的线索，仅依靠自身对弯曲的感知。

body.en: A research team from INRAE and the University Clermont Auvergne has shown that trees are capable of correcting a curvature they detect in their stems through a specific biological process. In the study, young trees with bent stems were placed in an experimental set-up that prevented them from sensing their orientation relative to light and gravity. The only sense remaining to the trees was the perception of their own curvature. Under these conditions, the scientists observed the formation of a particular type of wood, known as tension wood, which acts like a muscle to correct the curvature of the stem, allowing it to realign within a few weeks.
body.zh: 来自INRAE和克莱蒙奥弗涅大学的一个研究小组表明，树木能够通过特定的生物过程纠正它们在茎中检测到的弯曲。在这项研究中，茎弯曲的幼树被放置在一个实验装置中，阻止它们感知相对于光和重力的方向。树木唯一剩下的感觉就是它们自身曲率的感知。在这些条件下，科学家们观察到一种特殊类型木材的形成，称为张力木材，它像肌肉一样纠正茎的弯曲度，使其在几周内重新排列。

reflection.en: The intricate design of trees, capable of self-correction through specialized wood acting like a muscle, reveals a profound wisdom inherent in creation. This natural marvel invites us to consider the intelligence and purpose woven into the fabric of life, pointing to a Creator whose artistry is displayed even in the silent growth of a plant. "But ask the...
reflection.zh: 树木精妙的设计，能够通过像肌肉一样的特殊木材进行自我纠正，揭示了创造物中固有的深刻智慧。这一自然奇迹促使我们思考生命结构中编织的智慧和目的，指向一位其艺术即使在植物的沉默生长中也得以展现的创造者。 “但你们可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们会告诉你；或与地说话，它会教导你；海中的鱼，它们会告诉你。这一切之中，谁不知道雅伟的手所做的呢？”

title.en: Trapped light generates nanoscale magnetization
title.zh: 捕获的光产生纳米磁化

summary.en: Cornell University researchers have developed a novel method to create strong static magnetic fields without external magnets or magnetic materials by using an engineered metasurface that traps light. This breakthrough has the potential to advance fields such as spintronics, quantum and photonic computing, and data...
summary.zh: 康奈尔大学的研究人员利用一种能够捕获光的工程超表面，开发出一种无需外部磁铁或磁性材料即可产生强静磁场的新方法。这一突破有望推动自旋电子学、量子计算、光子计算和数据存储等领域的发展。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Using an engineered metasurface that traps light, Cornell researchers have demonstrated a new way to generate strong static magnetic fields without using external magnets or magnetic materials—an approach that could advance spintronics, quantum and photonic computing, and data storage.

In an article published in Advanced Science , Shivaksh Rawat, a Ph.D. candidate working with Gennady Shvets, the J. Preston Levis Professor of Engineering in the School of Applied and Engineering Physics, and Samyobrata Mukherjee, a postdoc in the same group, described how a new technique for light manipulation—the so-called "time interface"—can be used to convert part of an optical wave's energy into static magnetization.

When a light wave experiences a spatial interface—for example, when it travels through air and then water—some of the light is reflected off the surface while the rest is transmitted through it. Similarly, when a light wave experiences a time interface—a sudden change in the optical properties of the propagation medium, such as an increase or decrease in the refractive index—it also produces reflected and transmitted waves.

However, a time interface can also excite a static zero-frequency mode of the system; in other words, stopping part of the light's rapidly varying magnetic field and converting it into a stationary magnetic field pattern that remains in place instead of continuing to oscillate.

To create a time interface, the researchers used a 2D metasurface—a carefully engineered rectangular array of germanium nanostructures designed to trap mid-infrared light. The researchers wondered what would happen if the metasurface were illuminated with an intense, short burst of higher-energy (near-infrared) photons while the mid-infrared light was still inside the structure.

Their modeling revealed that the near-infrared light released electrons from the germanium atoms, leaving "electron holes" and many free electrons. The rapid generation of electron-hole pairs by the near-infrared light can create a time-dependent change in the light's refractive index that acts as a time interface for the trapped mid-infrared light.

"We used an approach known as localized free carrier generation, which has advantages over other methods of nanoscale magnetization," Rawat said. "One of the important contributions of our work is that our approach is material agnostic. Any nonmetallic surface will work."

During the time interface, some of the initial energy in the trapped light shifts to new red-shifted light waves, while the rest is trapped as the kinetic energy of circulating free...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 康奈尔大学的研究人员利用一种捕获光的工程超表面，展示了一种无需使用外部磁铁或磁性材料即可产生强静磁场的新方法，这种方法可以推进自旋电子学、量子和光子计算以及数据存储。 博士 Shivaksh Rawat 发表在《Advanced Science》上的一篇文章中。与应用与工程物理学院 J. Preston Levis 工程教授 Gennady Shvets 和同一小组的博士后 Samyobrata Mukherjee 合作的候选人描述了如何使用一种光操纵新技术——所谓的“时间界面”——将部分光波能量转换为静态磁化强度。 当光波经历空间界面时（例如，当它穿过空气然后穿过水时），一些光会从表面反射，而其余的则通过表面传播。同样，当光波经历时间界面（传播介质光学特性的突然变化，例如折射率的增加或减少）时，它也会产生反射波和透射波。 然而，时间接口也可以激发系统的静态零频率模式；换句话说，停止部分光快速变化的磁场，并将其转换为保持在原位而不是继续振荡的固定磁场模式。 为了创建时间界面，研究人员使用了二维超表面——一种精心设计的矩形锗纳米结构阵列，旨在捕获中红外光。研究人员想知道，如果超表面被强烈、短时的高能（近红外）光子照射，而中红外光仍在结构内部，会发生什么。 他们的模型显示，近红外光从锗原子中释放了电子，留下了“电子空穴”和许多自由电子。近红外光快速生成电子空穴对可以产生光折射率随时间的变化，该折射率充当捕获的中红外光的时间界面。 “我们使用了一种称为局部自由载流子生成的方法，它比其他纳米级磁化方法具有优势，”拉瓦特说。 “我们工作的重要贡献之一是我们的方法与材料无关。任何非金属表面都可以使用。” 在时间界面期间，被捕获光中的一些初始能量转变为新的红移光波，而其余的被捕获为循环自由的动能......

reflection.en: The Psalmist asks, 'The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.' (Psalm 19:1). In a similar vein, Job observes that 'the earth and all that is in it, the world and all its inhabitants, belong to Yahweh' (Job 12:9). The ingenuity of Cornell researchers, harnessing light to create magnetic fields, is a testament to the...
reflection.zh: 诗人问道：“诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，穹苍传扬他手的作为。”（诗篇19:1）。约伯也观察到：“地和其中所充满的，世界和其中所居住的，都属乎雅伟。”（约伯记12:9）。康奈尔大学研究人员利用光来产生磁场的创造性智慧，证明了被造界中错综复杂的奇迹，邀请我们去探索和理解雅伟编织在宇宙结构中的规律。

title.en: Copper's oxygen-rich early oxidation layer could inform catalyst design and nuclear waste storage
title.zh: 铜的富氧早期氧化层可用于催化剂设计和核废料储存

summary.en: Copper roofs develop a protective pale green copper oxide layer over time, preventing further corrosion. Researchers are investigating the initial steps of this process, which could have implications for designing catalysts and for the safe storage of nuclear waste in copper containers.
summary.zh: 铜屋顶会随着时间推移形成一层保护性的淡绿色氧化铜层，防止进一步腐蚀。研究人员正在调查这一过程的初始阶段，这可能对设计催化剂以及在铜容器中安全储存核废料产生影响。

body.en: Copper roofs lose their reddish color over time because a pale green layer of copper oxide forms on their surface, protecting the roof from further corrosion for many years. But what exactly happens during the first steps of this process? Might it even be possible to stop it? This question has become increasingly urgent since copper containers have come to be regarded as one of the best options for storing nuclear waste.
body.zh: 随着时间的推移，铜屋顶会失去红色，因为其表面会形成淡绿色的氧化铜层，从而保护屋顶多年免遭进一步腐蚀。但在此过程的第一步中到底发生了什么？甚至有可能阻止它吗？由于铜容器已被视为储存核废料的最佳选择之一，这个问题变得越来越紧迫。

reflection.en: The natural processes of creation, like the oxidation of copper, hold profound lessons. By observing and understanding these phenomena, humanity can develop innovative solutions for complex challenges, such as storing hazardous materials safely. This reminds us that wisdom is often found by carefully observing the world around us.
reflection.zh: 大自然的进程，例如铜的氧化，蕴含着深刻的教训。通过观察和理解这些现象，人类可以为储存危险材料等复杂挑战开发创新的解决方案。这提醒我们，智慧常常在于仔细观察我们周围的世界。

verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Widow whose husband died after falling into slurry pit warns of pressure on farmers
title.zh: 丈夫死于粪坑的寡妇警告农民面临的压力

summary.en: Margaret Owen states that 'things are getting worse' following an increase in worker fatalities on British farms. Her husband, Islwyn, died after falling into a slurry pit in 2024, a tragedy that has been brought back to her by the recent deaths of a father and son in similar circumstances. Official figures show 22...
summary.zh: 玛格丽特·欧文表示，“情况正在变得更糟”，此前英国农场工人的死亡人数有所增加。她的丈夫伊斯林于2024年 fall into a slurry pit，这一悲剧因上周一对父子在类似情况下死亡而再次浮现在她脑海中。官方数据显示，2025-26年度有22名农场工人死亡，是十年来最高纪录。

body.en:
The widow of a farmer who died after he fell into a slurry pit has spoken about the stresses facing workers after a rise in deaths.

Margaret Owen said the impact of husband Islwyn's death had been brought back to her once again following reports that a father and son had died in similar circumstances last week.

She said Islwyn had worried about bad weather and recently-introduced rules on slurry spreading when he had fallen at his farm in Bala, Gwynedd, in 2024.

Latest figures from the Health and Safety Executive (HSE) show 22 workers died on British farms during 2025-26 - the highest number in a decade.

Margaret said the number of deaths had made it appear "things are getting worse and worse".

An inquest into Islwyn's death found he had fallen into the slurry pit after he had climbed on to a short wall to adjust some machinery at Cefn Bodig farm in Llanycil, Bala.

He suffered asphyxia along with serious injuries to his right arm and chest caused by the machinery, and his body was found by a neighbour 90 minutes after he was reported missing on the evening of 4 September 2024.

Margaret said that, although it had not been the cause of his death, Islwyn had been under pressure because of a combination of bad weather and the Welsh government's rules that banned farmers from spreading slurry between mid-October to January.

The ban on muck-spreading over winter months to protect rivers is something that Wales' environment minister Llyr Gruffydd has said he wanted to change after Plaid Cymru came into power.

"The weather had been wet and there was a problem with mixing the slurry and emptying the slurry before the cattle came in - it was quite a stressful situation," she told BBC Cymru Fyw.

The deaths of Alan Ford, 72, and his son Rick, 42, after they had fallen into an industrial slurry tank at a farm in Chester on 26 August, had brought back memories of her husband's death, she said.

The 22 deaths of workers on farms in Wales, England and Scotland during 2025-26 was the highest in a decade, and second only to the number of deaths of those working in construction (27), according to HSE figures. , external

But the rate of farm deaths was seven times higher per 100,000 workers, and 21 times more likely than the all-industry average.

"It seems that things are getting worse and worse", Margaret said, and that "four [people] within four miles of here have died in recent years - it's scary isn't it?"

"Islwyn was so careful - one of those rare farmers who wore a helmet," she said.

She said she had known something was wrong on the day Islwyn died "because he was never very late for dinner", and said the nature of his death had been "hard to accept".

Margaret had to sell their farm stock and arrange for other farmers to rent the majority of their...
body.zh: 一名掉入泥浆坑身亡的农民的遗孀谈到了死亡人数上升后工人们面临的压力。 玛格丽特·欧文 (Margaret Owen) 表示，上周有报道称，一对父子在类似情况下死亡，丈夫伊斯文 (Islwyn) 去世的影响再次浮现在她心头。 她说，伊斯文于 2024 年在圭内斯巴拉的农场摔倒，当时他担心恶劣天气，最近出台了关于泥浆扩散的规定。 英国健康与安全执行局 (HSE) 的最新数据显示，2025-26 年间，英国农场有 22 名工人死亡，这是十年来的最高数字。 玛格丽特说，死亡人数表明“情况变得越来越糟”。 对 Islwyn 死亡的调查发现，他在巴拉兰尼西尔的 Cefn Bodig 农场爬上一堵短墙调整一些机械后掉进了泥浆坑。 他因机器造成窒息，右臂和胸部严重受伤，2024 年 9 月 4 日晚，他被报告失踪 90 分钟后，他的尸体被邻居发现。 玛格丽特说，虽然这不是他的死因，但由于恶劣天气和威尔士政府禁止农民在十月中旬至一月期间撒播泥浆的规定，伊斯文一直承受着压力。 威尔士环境部长利尔·格鲁菲德 (Llyr Gruffydd) 表示，在格莱德·西姆鲁 (Plaid Cymru) 上台后，他希望改变冬季月份为保护河流而禁止撒播淤泥的禁令。 她告诉 BBC Cymru Fyw：“天气潮湿，在牛进来之前混合泥浆和清空泥浆存在问题 - 这是一个相当紧张的情况。” 她说，72 岁的艾伦·福特和 42 岁的儿子里克于 8 月 26 日掉进切斯特一家农场的工业泥浆罐后死亡，这让她回想起丈夫的死亡。 根据 HSE 数据，2025-26 年间，威尔士、英格兰和苏格兰农场工人死亡 22 人，为十年来最高，仅次于建筑业工人死亡人数（27 人）。 , external 但每 10 万名工人的农场死亡率高出 7 倍，比全行业平均水平高出 21 倍。 玛格丽特说，“情况似乎变得越来越糟”，“近年来，这里四英里范围内有四个人死亡——这很可怕不是吗？” “伊斯文非常小心——他是罕见的戴头盔的农民之一，”她说。 她说，伊斯文去世的那天，她就知道出了什么问题，“因为他吃晚饭从来没有迟到过”，并表示他的死亡性质“难以接受”。 玛格丽特不得不卖掉他们的农场库存并安排其他农民租用他们的大部分...

reflection.en: The tragic death of Islwyn Owen, and the subsequent warning from his widow Margaret, underscores the immense pressures faced by farmers. The rising number of fatalities, including Islwyn's, highlights a systemic vulnerability. In the face of such hardship and loss, we are called to advocate for those whose livelihoods are precarious and whose voices may be...
reflection.zh: 伊斯林·欧文的悲惨去世以及他的遗孀玛格丽特发出的警告，凸显了农民面临的巨大压力。包括伊斯林在内的死亡人数不断增加，表明存在系统性的脆弱性。面对这样的困境和损失，我们被呼召去为那些生计艰难、在挣扎中可能被忽视的声音发声。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Scientists may have found first hint of dark matter
title.zh: 科学家可能已发现暗物质的第一个迹象

summary.en: Scientists believe they may be one step closer to detecting dark matter for the first time, but the findings have not been verified by independent researchers. The material is thought to make up over 85% of the universe and has eluded detection for nearly a century.
summary.zh: 科学家们认为他们可能更接近于首次探测到暗物质，但这些发现尚未得到独立研究人员的核实。这种物质被认为占宇宙的85%以上，近一个世纪以来一直难以被探测到。

body.en:
Scientists believe they may be one step closer to detecting dark matter for the first time, but the findings have not been verified by independent researchers.

Scientists from the University of Bristol were part of a two-year study to try and measure the invisible substance thought to make up over 85% of the universe.

Using a sensitive detector in an an underground laboratory in the US, the researchers saw an atom and mystery particle colliding.

Lead researcher physicist Dr Sam Eriksen said it could be "the first step in understanding dark matter as a particle", but further research could also reveal that the particle is not related to dark matter.

"Following a huge amount of scientific effort, this is incredibly exciting," the University of Bristol senior research associate added.

Although scientists have long been certain of the existence of dark matter, because it is invisible as it reflects no light.

While it is thought to make up the majority of mass in the universe, it has never been directly detected.

For two years, 250 scientists and engineers from 39 institutions spanning six countries, including two universities from the UK, have rigorously scrutinised data from one of the world's most sensitive dark matter detectors called LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ).

It is managed by the US Department of Energy's Sanford Underground Research Facility in South Dakota - the deepest laboratory in the US at nearly a mile beneath the ground.

To search for dark matter, LZ uses extremely sensitive light detectors to capture particle interactions.

The study found one particle interaction which could potentially have been caused by a Weakly Interacting Massive Particle, (WIMP), which scientists believe make up dark matter.

But there is currently low statistical evidence in it being a true breakthrough.

The findings were revealed at a conference in Japan on Tuesday, but the research has yet to undergo peer-review by other scientists.

The findings have been rated 2.6 sigma, which is the system that marks the statistical significance of discoveries. The normal threshold is five.

"With only one event, we don't want to get ahead of ourselves," said Professor Rick Gaitskell from Brown University.

"We are not claiming to have seen dark matter. But we have seen something interesting that we want to share with the scientific community for their input."

Professor Henning Flaecher, an experimental particle physicist at the University of Bristol, said a "huge amount" of work had been carried out over "countless hours" to investigate any previously known reasons researchers might have observed the unusual reaction.

"It's an incredibly exciting time, the kind of event every astro-particle physicist dreams of, and we can't wait to analyse more data to see if additional...
body.zh: 科学家认为，他们可能距离首次探测暗物质又近了一步，但这一发现尚未得到独立研究人员的证实。 布里斯托大学的科学家参与了一项为期两年的研究，试图测量这种被认为占宇宙 85% 以上的无形物质。 研究人员在美国地下实验室使用灵敏探测器，看到了原子和神秘粒子的碰撞。 首席研究员物理学家萨姆·埃里克森博士表示，这可能是“将暗物质理解为粒子的第一步”，但进一步的研究也可能揭示该粒子与暗物质无关。 “经过大量的科学努力，这是非常令人兴奋的，”布里斯托大学高级研究员补充道。 尽管科学家们早已确定暗物质的存在，但因为它不反射光，所以是不可见的。 虽然它被认为构成了宇宙中的大部分质量，但它从未被直接探测到。 两年来，来自六个国家 39 个机构（包括两所英国大学）的 250 名科学家和工程师严格审查了来自世界上最灵敏的暗物质探测器之一 LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) 的数据。 它由美国能源部位于南达科他州的桑福德地下研究设施管理，该设施是美国最深的实验室，位于地下近一英里处。 为了寻找暗物质，LZ 使用极其灵敏的光探测器来捕捉粒子相互作用。 该研究发现一种粒子相互作用可能是由弱相互作用大质量粒子（WIMP）引起的，科学家认为它构成了暗物质。 但目前很少有统计证据表明它是真正的突破。 该研究结果于周二在日本举行的一次会议上公布，但该研究尚未经过其他科学家的同行评审。 研究结果的评级为 2.6 sigma，该系统标志着发现的统计显着性。正常阈值是五。 布朗大学的里克·盖茨克尔教授说：“只有一项活动，我们不想超出自己的预期。” “我们并不是声称看到了暗物质。但我们看到了一些有趣的东西，我们希望与科学界分享，以征求他们的意见。” 布里斯托大学实验粒子物理学家亨宁·弗莱彻教授表示，已经在“无数个小时”内进行了“大量”工作，以调查研究人员可能观察到这种不寻常反应的任何先前已知原因。 “这是一个令人难以置信的激动人心的时刻，是每个天体粒子物理学家都梦想的事件，我们迫不及待地想分析更多数据，看看是否还有更多……

reflection.en: For nearly a century, scientists have sought to understand dark matter, the invisible substance comprising most of the universe. Their recent, though unverified, potential detection highlights humanity's persistent quest for knowledge through observing the cosmos. As Job 12:7-9 reminds us, 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the air,...
reflection.zh: 近一个世纪以来，科学家们一直致力于了解暗物质，这种构成宇宙大部分的看不见的物质。他们最近的潜在探测，尽管尚未得到证实，但凸显了人类通过观察宇宙来不懈追求知识的努力。正如约伯书12:7-9所提醒的：“你可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们会告诉你；或对大地说话，它会教导你；海中的鱼，它们会向你解释。”...

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: US medical groups urge people to get flu and Covid shots in counter to Trump guidance
title.zh: 美国医学团体呼吁接种流感和新冠疫苗，以对抗特朗普的指导方针

summary.en: Leading US medical groups are urging people to get updated flu and Covid-19 vaccinations this fall, banding together to issue shot guidelines and highlight the science behind them, aiming to ease confusion caused by the Trump administration’s changing immunization advice.
summary.zh: 美国顶尖医学团体正在敦促人们在今年秋季接种更新的流感和新冠疫苗，他们联合发布了疫苗接种指南，并强调其背后的科学依据，旨在缓解特朗普政府不断变化的免疫接种建议所造成的困惑。

body.en: Top medical groups band together to ease confusion from Trump administration’s changing immunization advice Leading US medical groups are urging people to get updated flu and Covid-19 vaccinations this fall, banding together on Wednesday to issue shot guidelines – and highlight the science behind them – saying they hope to ease confusion caused by the Trump administration’s changing advice. Flu vaccinations are beginning and the latest coronavirus shots are starting to arrive after the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved this year’s updated versions last week. Winter also brings another vaccine-preventable risk called RSV. Continue reading...
body.zh: 顶级医疗团体联合起来，以缓解特朗普政府不断变化的免疫建议带来的困惑美国主要医疗团体敦促人们在今年秋天接种最新的流感和 Covid-19 疫苗，并于周三联合发布疫苗接种指南，并强调其背后的科学依据，表示他们希望缓解因特朗普政府不断变化的建议而造成的混乱。在美国食品和药物管理局 (FDA) 上周批准了今年的更新版本后，流感疫苗接种工作已经开始，最新的冠状病毒疫苗也开始上市。冬季还带来了另一种可以通过疫苗预防的风险，即 RSV。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In times of shifting public health guidance, clear, science-based advice is crucial. The collaboration of medical groups to offer unified recommendations demonstrates the value of seeking and heeding expert counsel, especially when navigating complex health decisions. This collective effort aims to bring clarity and confidence to the public.
reflection.zh: 在公共卫生指导方针不断变化的时期，清晰、基于科学的建议至关重要。医学团体联合起来提供统一的建议，这体现了在应对复杂的健康决策时，寻求和听取专家意见的价值。这种集体努力旨在为公众带来清晰和信心。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Interstellar solar sails hit a strange problem at 75% of light speed
title.zh: 星际太阳帆在光速的75%时遇到奇怪的问题

summary.en: Solar sails propelled by powerful lasers could achieve incredible speeds, but relativity might eventually cause the light itself to impede them. At approximately 75% of the speed of light, scattered photons can create drag, presenting a surprising obstacle to interstellar travel.
summary.zh: 由强大激光驱动的太阳帆可以达到惊人的速度，但相对论最终可能会使光本身成为阻碍。在光速的75%左右，散射的光子会产生阻力，为星际旅行带来了令人惊讶的障碍。

body.en:
Reaching another star within a practical amount of time will require something far more capable than chemical rockets. One of the leading ideas is a solar sail, a large reflective structure that can be pushed by light. If extremely powerful lasers are aimed at such a sail, they could accelerate it to speeds well beyond what current propulsion systems can achieve.

But there may be an unexpected problem once a lightsail begins traveling at a significant fraction of the speed of light. According to a new paper on arXiv by Chao Shen and Jiaze Li of the Harbin Institute of Technology, the same light used to propel the sail could eventually produce a drag effect.

The researchers separate the forces produced by photons striking a solar sail into three categories.

The strongest contribution comes from incident light (that raw momentum of the photons hitting the sail). Next is specular reflection (momentum imparted when photons bounce perfectly off the sail). The weakest contribution comes from diffuse scattering (momentum from photons that are absorbed by the sail then reemitted in random directions).

At relatively low speeds, these effects all contribute to pushing the sail forward. The situation becomes much more complicated once the spacecraft reaches relativistic velocities.

As the sail races away from the laser source, the light reaching it undergoes an increasingly strong Doppler shift. The frequency of the incoming light decreases, reducing the amount of thrust produced by all three components.

As a result, continued acceleration becomes progressively less efficient. The faster the sail travels, the harder it becomes for the laser to keep increasing its speed.

The situation changes even more dramatically once the lightsail reaches about 75% of the speed of light.

At that speed, relativistic light aberration becomes important. From the viewpoint of a stationary observer on Earth, diffusely scattered light begins to be directed forward, toward the direction in which the sail is traveling.

Because every action has an equal and opposite reaction, that forward-directed radiation produces a force in the opposite direction. This means diffuse scattering (admittedly the weakest of the three forces) begins acting as drag once the sail passes roughly 75% of the speed of light.

The laser is still pushing the sail forward overall, so the total force does not become negative. However, the efficiency of the propulsion system drops substantially.

The study is focused specifically on radiative dynamics. It does not include nonradiative effects such as collisions and drag from interstellar gas or dust.

It also leaves out the thermal limits of real sail materials. A sail exposed to an extremely powerful laser could potentially overheat or even melt.

body.zh: 在实际时间内到达另一颗恒星将需要比化学火箭能力更强的东西。其中一个领先的想法是太阳帆，这是一种可以由光推动的大型反射结构。如果极其强大的激光瞄准这样的帆，它们可以将其加速到远远超出当前推进系统所能达到的速度。 但一旦光帆开始以光速的很大一部分行驶，可能会出现意想不到的问题。根据哈尔滨工业大学沉超和李嘉泽在 arXiv 上发表的一篇新论文，用于推进帆的相同光最终可能会产生阻力效果。 研究人员将光子撞击太阳帆产生的力分为三类。 最强的贡献来自入射光（光子撞击帆的原始动量）。接下来是镜面反射（当光子从帆上完美反弹时产生的动量）。最弱的贡献来自漫散射（被帆吸收然后以随机方向重新发射的光子的动量）。 在相对较低的速度下，这些效应都有助于推动帆前进。一旦航天器达到相对论速度，情况就会变得更加复杂。 当帆远离激光源时，到达它的光会经历越来越强的多普勒频移。入射光的频率降低，从而减少了所有三个部件产生的推力。 结果，持续加速的效率逐渐降低。帆行进的速度越快，激光就越难保持其速度。 一旦光帆达到光速的 75% 左右，情况就会发生更大的变化。 在这样的速度下，相对论光像差变得很重要。从地球上静止的观察者的角度来看，漫散射光开始向前引导，朝向帆行驶的方向。 因为每个动作都有相等且相反的反应，所以向前的辐射会产生相反方向的力。这意味着一旦帆经过大约 75% 的光速，漫散射（公认的三种力中最弱的一种）就开始充当阻力。 激光仍然在整体上推动帆前进，因此总力不会变成负值。然而，推进系统的效率大幅下降。 该研究特别关注辐射动力学。它不包括非辐射效应，例如星际气体或尘埃的碰撞和阻力。 它还忽略了真实帆材料的热限制。暴露在极其强大的激光下的帆可能会过热甚至融化。 为了...

reflection.en: Humanity's quest to explore the stars, as described in this report on solar sails, is a testament to our God-given curiosity and ingenuity. Yet, as we push the boundaries of physics, we encounter the universe's intricate laws, reminding us that even our most advanced knowledge is still unfolding. The prophet Daniel foresaw a time when 'knowledge shall...
reflection.zh: 人类探索星辰的追求，正如这篇关于太阳帆的报道所述，证明了我们上帝所赐的好奇心和创造力。然而，当我们突破物理学的界限时，我们会遇到宇宙错综复杂的定律，这提醒我们，即使是我们最先进的知识仍在不断发展。先知但以理预见到一个“知识必增长”的时代——这恰如其分地描述了我们持续的科学探索。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Money problems may age your brain faster
title.zh: 金钱问题可能加速您的大脑衰老

summary.en: New research indicates that enduring financial difficulties in early and middle adulthood are associated with diminished cognitive abilities and increased signs of brain aging by later life. The study suggests that chronic stress and worry stemming from financial hardship may progressively harm the brain.
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，成年早期和中期持续的经济困难与晚年认知能力下降和大脑衰老迹象增加有关。研究表明，经济困难带来的慢性压力和担忧可能逐渐损害大脑。

body.en:
Persistent financial hardship may speed up age-related cognitive decline, according to new research led by University College London (UCL).

Published in Innovation in Aging , the study analyzed information from 2,759 people in the UK who completed questionnaires across much of their lives through the MRC National Survey of Health and Development (also known as the 1946 British cohort study).

Researchers found that people who faced ongoing financial difficulties or persistently low income during early and middle adulthood tended to perform worse on cognitive tests by the age of 53.

Among a subgroup who later underwent brain scans, persistent low income was also associated with poorer brain health (including more brain shrinkage) in later life (ages 69 to 71).

These associations remained after the researchers accounted for other factors that could have influenced the results, including childhood cognitive ability, education level and childhood disadvantage.

Corresponding author Dr. Jacques Wels (Unit for Lifelong Health & Ageing at UCL) said: "Most studies on cognitive aging look at financial hardship at only a single point in time. Our study using several decades of data allows us to see that it is the accumulation of hardship over many years that is linked to the worst cognitive health outcomes, rather than occasional episodes of adversity."

Senior author Professor Praveetha Patalay (Unit for Lifelong Health & Ageing and Centre for Longitudinal Studies, UCL) said: "Our findings suggest that supporting people facing financial hardship and reducing chronic poverty could also help prevent cognitive decline and dementia cases in the future."

The relationship between financial adversity and poorer brain health later in life appeared especially strong among men, people who had experienced childhood disadvantage, and those who carried APOE-ε4, a genetic variant associated with an increased risk of Alzheimer's disease.

Men who experienced persistent financial adversity also performed worse on cognitive tests at age 53 than their female counterparts.

The researchers suggested several possible explanations for this difference. Disadvantaged men may have been more likely than disadvantaged women to engage in unhealthy behaviors (such as smoking and alcohol misuse). Men in this generation may also have experienced financial strain differently because they were more likely to have been the primary breadwinners in this cohort born in 1946.

Several biological and psychological pathways could help explain the connection between financial hardship and cognitive aging.

One possibility is inflammation. Chronic stress can promote inflammation, which is known to contribute to faster brain aging.

body.zh: 伦敦大学学院（UCL）领导的最新研究表明，持续的经济困难可能会加速与年龄相关的认知能力下降。 该研究发表在《老龄化创新》杂志上，分析了 2,759 名英国人的信息，这些人通过 MRC 国家健康与发展调查（也称为 1946 年英国队列研究）完成了一生中大部分时间的调查问卷。 研究人员发现，在成年早期和中期面临持续经济困难或持续低收入的人到 53 岁时在认知测试中往往表现较差。 在后来接受脑部扫描的一个亚群中，持续的低收入也与晚年（69 至 71 岁）大脑健康状况较差（包括更多的大脑萎缩）有关。 在研究人员考虑了可能影响结果的其他因素（包括儿童认知能力、教育水平和儿童劣势）后，这些关联仍然存在。 通讯作者雅克·韦尔斯博士（伦敦大学学院终身健康与老龄化部门）表示：“大多数关于认知衰老的研究只着眼于单个时间点的经济困难。我们使用数十年数据的研究使我们看到，与最糟糕的认知健康结果相关的是多年困难的积累，而不是偶尔的逆境。” 资深作者 Praveetha Patalay 教授（伦敦大学学院终身健康与老龄化部门和纵向研究中心）表示：“我们的研究结果表明，支持面临经济困难的人们和减少长期贫困也有助于预防未来的认知能力下降和痴呆症病例。” 经济逆境与晚年大脑健康状况不佳之间的关系在男性、童年经历过不利条件的人和携带 APOE-ε4（一种与阿尔茨海默氏病风险增加相关的基因变异）的人中显得尤其强烈。 经历持续的经济逆境的男性在 53 岁时的认知测试中也表现得比女性同行更差。 研究人员对这种差异提出了几种可能的解释。弱势男性可能比弱势女性更有可能从事不健康行为（例如吸烟和酗酒）。这一代的男性也可能经历了不同的经济压力，因为他们更有可能是 1946 年出生的这一代人中的主要养家糊口者。 一些生物和心理途径可以帮助解释经济困难和认知衰老之间的联系。 一种可能性是炎症。慢性压力会促进炎症，众所周知，炎症会加速大脑老化。 对财务状况的持续担忧也可能会增加......

reflection.en: This study highlights how persistent financial struggles can take a tangible toll on our cognitive health, accelerating brain aging. It serves as a somber reminder of the profound impact of our circumstances on our well-being, urging us to seek wisdom in how we navigate life's challenges and value our time.
reflection.zh: 这项研究强调，持续的经济困境会对我们的认知健康造成切实的损害，加速大脑衰老。它警示我们，生活环境对身心健康的深远影响，并促使我们在应对生活挑战和珍惜时光时寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verse.textZh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。

title.en: Alzheimer’s may leave a mark on the brain long before plaques appear
title.zh: 阿尔茨海默病可能在斑块出现前很久就在大脑留下印记

summary.en: New research suggests that brain changes linked to Alzheimer's disease may begin at least seven years before amyloid plaques are detectable by current PET scans. Scientists tracked healthy older adults using repeated brain imaging over nearly two decades, identifying structural changes years before plaques became...
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，与阿尔茨海默病相关的脑部变化可能在现有PET扫描可检测到淀粉样蛋白斑块之前的至少七年就开始出现。研究人员通过对健康老年人近二十年的重复脑部成像追踪，在斑块变得可见前数年就识别出了结构性变化。

body.en:
A new study suggests that brain imaging could reveal changes linked to Alzheimer's disease more than seven years earlier than researchers previously believed. The work was led by scientists in the Department of Psychology at the University of Oslo and was published in Nature Neuroscience.

The study suggests that the current gold standard for Alzheimer's imaging (amyloid-PET) may not be sensitive enough to capture some of the earliest brain changes associated with the disease. These include processes related to the buildup of amyloid plaques. The researchers identified structural changes in the brain at least seven years before plaques became visible on scans.

"We found that structural changes in the brain occur many years before high levels of plaque are seen on PET scans, which is the brain scan currently used to identify the earliest signs of Alzheimer's disease," says James Michael Roe.

At the time the research was carried out, Roe was a postdoctoral researcher at the Center for Lifespan Changes in Brain and Cognition (LCBC) at the Department of Psychology, University of Oslo. He now works as International Scientific Lead at Cercare Medical. Roe was the study's main researcher while working at LCBC.

According to Roe, the results suggest that disease-related processes may already be developing in the brain long before they can be seen with today's most sensitive imaging methods.

"We found the earliest signal detected on brain scans to date, which could be useful for tracking the disease before symptoms emerge and may help with earlier detection," he says.

To uncover these early changes, the researchers followed healthy individuals who underwent regular brain scans (MRI) for nearly 20 years. The long span of imaging data allowed the team to determine when plaques first became detectable and which participants eventually developed them.

The researchers then looked back at MRI scans collected during the previous decade. They compared changes in brain structure among people who later showed plaques with changes seen in people who did not.

"The most groundbreaking aspect of this study is that we found structural changes in the brain many years before the first signs of plaque buildup, which is considered to be the earliest sign of Alzheimer's disease," says Anders Martin Fjell, Professor at the Department of Psychology, and head of LCBC.

"These are cognitively well-functioning older individuals. What is unique here is that we have examined changes in brain structure in the years before the first scan revealed plaques," says Fjell.

Fjell notes that Alzheimer's disease remains extremely difficult to treat. One reason is that it is closely connected with aging and is probably influenced by several different biological factors.
