body.zh: 一项新的研究表明，大脑成像可以比研究人员之前认为的早七年多揭示与阿尔茨海默病相关的变化。这项工作由奥斯陆大学心理学系的科学家领导，并发表在《自然神经科学》杂志上。 该研究表明，目前阿尔茨海默病成像的黄金标准（淀粉样蛋白-PET）可能不够灵敏，无法捕捉到与该疾病相关的一些最早的大脑变化。这些包括与淀粉样斑块形成相关的过程。研究人员在斑块在扫描中变得可见之前至少七年就发现了大脑的结构变化。 詹姆斯·迈克尔·罗伊 (James Michael Roe) 表示：“我们发现，在 PET 扫描中看到大量斑块之前，大脑的结构变化就已经发生了很多年，而 PET 扫描是目前用于识别阿尔茨海默病最早迹象的脑部扫描。” 在进行这项研究时，罗伊是奥斯陆大学心理学系大脑和认知寿命变化中心（LCBC）的博士后研究员。他现在担任 Cercare Medical 的国际科学主管。 Roe 在 LCBC 工作期间是该研究的主要研究员。 罗伊表示，研究结果表明，与疾病相关的过程可能早在当今最灵敏的成像方法能够看到之前就已经在大脑中形成了。 他说：“我们发现了迄今为止在脑部扫描中检测到的最早信号，这可能有助于在症状出现之前追踪疾病，并可能有助于早期检测。” 为了发现这些早期变化，研究人员对定期接受脑部扫描 (MRI) 的健康个体进行了近 20 年的跟踪调查。长跨度的成像数据使团队能够确定斑块首次被检测到的时间以及哪些参与者最终出现了斑块。 研究人员随后回顾了过去十年收集的核磁共振扫描结果。他们比较了后来出现斑块的人和没有出现斑块的人的大脑结构变化。 “这项研究最具开创性的一点是，我们在斑块形成的最初迹象出现之前很多年就发现了大脑的结构变化，这被认为是阿尔茨海默病的最早迹象，”心理学系教授兼 LCBC 负责人 Anders Martin Fjell 说。 “这些都是认知功能良好的老年人。这里的独特之处在于，我们在第一次扫描显示斑块之前的几年里就检查了大脑结构的变化，”菲杰尔说。 菲杰尔指出，阿尔茨海默病仍然极难治疗。原因之一是它与衰老密切相关，并且可能受到多种不同生物因素的影响。 “这些发现...

reflection.en: The intricate workings of the human brain, even in its earliest stages of decline, are a testament to the complex design of creation. This research, by observing and understanding these subtle changes, reflects a deep engagement with the mysteries Yahweh has woven into our physical being. It reminds us that even in the face of disease, the pursuit of...
reflection.zh: 人类大脑的复杂运作，即使在其衰退的早期阶段，也证明了造物主设计的精妙。这项研究通过观察和理解这些细微的变化，体现了对雅伟编织在我们物质存在中的奥秘的深刻探索。它提醒我们，即使面对疾病，对我们身体的知识追求也可以是对造物主工巧的尊崇。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: A coffee-table-size scorpion roamed Earth before forests existed
title.zh: 一种咖啡桌大小的蝎子在森林存在之前就已漫游地球

summary.en: A meter-long scorpion with massive pincers stalked ancient Britain 415 million years ago, long before forests and the better-known age of giant insects. Its surprising size and possible semi-aquatic lifestyle could reshape ideas about how early arthropods became giants.
summary.zh: 一种拥有巨大螯的、长达一米的蝎子在 4.15 亿年前的古代英国游荡，远在森林和更广为人知的巨型昆虫时代之前。它令人惊讶的体型和可能的半水生生活方式可能会重塑人们对早期节肢动物如何长成巨型的看法。

body.en:
A newly analyzed fossil predator from what is now England and Wales has been identified as the largest scorpion known to science. Researchers from The University of Manchester and the Natural History Museum reached the conclusion after revisiting fossils that had remained in museum collections for more than 150 years.

The animal, Praearcturus gigas , reached roughly one meter in length and carried pincers more than 16 centimeters long. Around 415 million years ago, it would have been an imposing predator in the floodplain environments of the Early Devonian.

A study published in Palaeontology used modern analytical methods and comparisons with more recently described fossil species to determine that Praearcturus was a scorpion and represented a distinct species.

Dr. Richard J. Howard, Curator of Fossil Arthropods at the Natural History Museum, London, and lead author of the study, said: "When we think of giant arthropods, people often picture Carboniferous rainforests with giant millipedes or dragonfly-like insects from later in Earth's history. But Praearcturus lived at least 50 million years earlier, well before the evolution of trees, when life on land was only just getting started.

"Confirming that this animal is a scorpion fundamentally changes our understanding of how and when these creatures evolved to such extraordinary sizes."

The discovery pushes the story of giant arthropods much further back in time than the period usually associated with enormous insects and other invertebrates.

Dr. Russell Garwood, Paleontologist at The University of Manchester, added: " Praearcturus has puzzled us paleontologists for more than a century. By bringing together material from several collections and using cutting-edge imaging techniques, we've been able to build a clearer picture of the animal than was previously possible, which is really exciting.

"What makes Praearcturus so interesting is that it became enormous at a time when life on land was otherwise very small. But it was a world that could somehow support a giant predator. To try and better understand this ancient world, we compared the size of fossil scorpions with other animals alive at the time. To reach such extraordinary sizes, and conclude that perhaps it lived in water, where life was bigger."

Praearcturus gigas lived during the Early Devonian, when terrestrial ecosystems were still in their infancy. Small plants and fungi had only recently begun spreading across the landscape, while forests and other complex land ecosystems had not yet developed.

That timing is important because Praearcturus lived before the high atmospheric oxygen levels associated with the later rise of forests. Those oxygen-rich conditions have often been linked to the enormous size of some later...
body.zh: 最近分析的来自现在英格兰和威尔士的捕食者化石已被确定为科学界已知的最大的蝎子。曼彻斯特大学和自然历史博物馆的研究人员在重新审视博物馆收藏了 150 多年的化石后得出了这一结论。 这种动物名为 Praearcturus gigas，体长约一米，钳子长度超过 16 厘米。大约 4.15 亿年前，它在早泥盆世的洪泛平原环境中是一种强大的掠食者。 发表在《古生物学》上的一项研究使用现代分析方法并与最近描述的化石物种进行比较，以确定 Praearcturus 是一种蝎子并且代表了一个独特的物种。 伦敦自然历史博物馆化石节肢动物馆长、该研究的主要作者理查德·J·霍华德博士说：“当我们想到巨型节肢动物时，人们经常会想到石炭纪雨林中生活着地球历史后期的巨型千足虫或蜻蜓状昆虫。但前陆龙生活在至少 5000 万年前，远远早于树木的进化，当时陆地上的生命才刚刚开始。 “确认这种动物是蝎子，从根本上改变了我们对这些生物如何以及何时进化到如此非凡体型的理解。” 这一发现将巨型节肢动物的故事推向了比通常与巨型昆虫和其他无脊椎动物相关的时期更早的时期。 曼彻斯特大学古生物学家拉塞尔·加伍德博士补充道：“近一个多世纪以来，近陆龙一直困扰着我们古生物学家。通过汇集多个收藏的材料并使用尖端的成像技术，我们已经能够比以前更清晰地了解该动物，这确实令人兴奋。 “使近地龙如此有趣的是，当陆地上的生命非常渺小时，它就变得非常巨大。但它是一个可以以某种方式支持巨型捕食者的世界。为了尝试更好地了解这个古老的世界，我们将蝎子化石的大小与当时活着的其他动物进行了比较。为了达到如此非凡的大小，并得出结论，它可能生活在水中，那里的生命更大。” Praearcturus gigas生活在泥盆纪早期，当时陆地生态系统仍处于起步阶段。小型植物和真菌最近才开始在这片土地上蔓延，而森林和其他复杂的陆地生态系统尚未发育。 这个时机很重要，因为近地龙生活在大气含氧量较高、森林后来兴起之前。这些富含氧气的条件通常与后来的一些巨大的尺寸有关......

reflection.en: The discovery of Praearcturus gigas, a scorpion that reached a meter in length 415 million years ago, reminds us that the natural world holds profound lessons. As Job observed, the creatures of the earth can teach us much about the Creator's wisdom and power. This ancient predator, existing long before forests, invites us to marvel at the deep history of...
reflection.zh: 发现长达一米的蝎子 Praearcturus gigas，生活在 4.15 亿年前，提醒我们自然界蕴含着深刻的教训。正如约伯所观察到的，地上的生物可以教会我们许多关于创造者的智慧和能力。这种古老的捕食者，存在于森林出现很久之前，邀请我们惊叹于生命的深厚历史以及编织在受造物中的精巧设计。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Astronauts set out on rare all-female spacewalk
title.zh: 宇航员进行罕见的首次全女性太空行走

summary.en: For the sixth time in history, a team of two women completed a spacewalk outside the International Space Station.
summary.zh: 历史上第六次，一支由两名女性组成的团队完成了在国际空间站外的太空行走。

reflection.en: Two women ventured into the vastness of space, a testament to human ingenuity and collaboration. In the face of the immense cosmos, we are reminded of the psalmist's wonder: 'What is man that you are mindful of him?' Yet, in this very act of exploration, humanity asserts its unique place and God-given dignity.
reflection.zh: 两位女性踏入了浩瀚的太空，这是人类智慧与协作的证明。面对浩瀚的宇宙，我们被提醒诗人的惊叹：“人算什么，你竟顾念他？”然而，正是通过这次探索，人类彰显了其独特的地位和雅伟所赐予的尊严。

verse.textEn: What is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
verse.textZh: 人算什么，你竟顾念他？

title.en: Will your name be the next UK storm?
title.zh: 你的名字会是下一个英国风暴的名字吗？

summary.en: The list of storm names for the upcoming year has been released. The question is whether personal names will be featured on this list.
summary.zh: 下一年的风暴名称列表已经发布。问题是个人名字是否会出现在这个名单上。

reflection.en: Each year, a list of names is compiled for storms in the UK. This practice, while practical, touches on the human desire for order and recognition. Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when knowledge will increase, and many will rush to and fro. In our age, this includes the proliferation of information and the systems we create to categorize and understand...
reflection.zh: 每年，英国都会为风暴编制一份名称列表。这种做法虽然实用，但触及了人类对秩序和认可的渴望。但以理的预言谈到知识增长的时代，许多人将往来奔走。在我们这个时代，这包括信息的泛滥以及我们为理解周围世界（甚至天气）而创建的分类系统。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Is Donald Trump 'supplying all that money' to Nasa?
title.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普是否“为美国宇航局提供了所有资金”？

summary.en: BBC Verify fact checks President Trump's funding claims about Nasa.
summary.zh: BBC Verify 事实核查了特朗普总统关于美国国家航空航天局（NASA）资金的说法。

reflection.en: When leaders make bold claims about funding and policy, it's crucial to seek out reliable information and expert analysis. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that 'where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.' Fact-checking claims, especially those concerning significant public resources like NASA's budget, helps...
reflection.zh: 当领导人对资金和政策做出大胆声明时，寻求可靠信息和专家分析至关重要。《箴言》11:14 提醒我们：“在没有指导的地方，人民会跌倒，但在谋士众多之处，就有安全。” 事实核查这些说法，特别是涉及美国国家航空航天局（NASA）预算等重要公共资源时，有助于确保问责制和明智的管理。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Too much coffee may weaken bones, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现：过量饮用咖啡可能损害骨骼

summary.en: A decade-long study of nearly 10,000 women aged 65 and older found that while moderate coffee intake showed no harm, consuming more than five cups daily was linked to lower bone density. Tea consumption, conversely, was associated with slightly higher hip bone density. These findings are significant given the...
summary.zh: 一项对近一万名65岁及以上女性进行的为期十年的研究发现，适量饮用咖啡似乎没有危害，但每天饮用超过五杯与较低的骨密度相关。相比之下，饮茶与髋骨密度略高相关。鉴于咖啡和茶的广泛消费以及骨质疏松症这一全球性健康问题，这些发现具有重要意义。

body.en:
Researchers at Flinders University have found new evidence that coffee and tea may have different relationships with bone health in older women.

Published in Nutrients , the study tracked nearly 10,000 women aged 65 and older for 10 years. The researchers examined whether regular coffee and tea consumption was associated with changes in bone mineral density (BMD), an important measure used to assess osteoporosis risk.

Osteoporosis is a major health problem worldwide. It affects roughly one in three women over age 50 and is responsible for millions of fractures each year. Because billions of people drink coffee or tea every day, even small effects on bone health could have broad implications. Previous research on the subject has produced mixed findings, and relatively few studies have followed participants for such a long period.

The Flinders University researchers used data from the Study of Osteoporotic Fractures. They repeatedly assessed participants' beverage habits and measured BMD at both the hip and femoral neck, two areas closely linked to fracture risk.

During the 10-year study period, the women regularly reported how much coffee and tea they drank. Researchers also used advanced imaging methods to monitor changes in their bone density.

The results showed that women who drank tea had slightly higher total hip BMD than those who did not drink tea. The difference was small, but it was statistically significant and could still matter when considered across large populations.

"Even small improvements in bone density can translate into fewer fractures across large groups," says Adjunct Associate Professor Enwu Liu from the College of Medicine and Public Health.

Coffee showed a more complicated pattern. Drinking moderate amounts, about two to three cups per day, was not associated with harm to bone health. However, women who drank more than five cups a day had lower BMD, suggesting that very high coffee consumption could have negative effects.

The relationship also appeared to differ depending on other health and lifestyle factors. Women with higher lifetime alcohol consumption experienced stronger negative effects associated with coffee, while the apparent benefits of tea were more pronounced among women with obesity.

Ryan Liu, co-author on the paper, says that compounds called catechins, abundant in tea, may promote bone formation and slow bone breakdown.

"Coffee's caffeine content, by contrast, has been shown in laboratory studies to interfere with calcium absorption and bone metabolism, though these effects are small and can be offset by adding milk," says Ryan Liu from Flinders University.

Adjunct Associate Professor Enwu Liu adds that the findings suggest that regularly drinking tea could offer a simple way to support bone health...
body.zh: 弗林德斯大学的研究人员发现了新的证据，表明咖啡和茶可能与老年女性的骨骼健康有不同的关系。 该研究发表在《营养》杂志上，对近 10,000 名 65 岁及以上的女性进行了长达 10 年的跟踪调查。研究人员检查了经常饮用咖啡和茶是否与骨矿物质密度（BMD）的变化有关，骨矿物质密度是评估骨质疏松症风险的重要指标。 骨质疏松症是世界范围内的一个主要健康问题。它影响大约三分之一的 50 岁以上女性，每年导致数百万例骨折。由于数十亿人每天喝咖啡或茶，即使对骨骼健康的微小影响也可能产生广泛的影响。之前关于这一主题的研究得出了不同的结果，而且相对较少的研究对参与者进行了如此长时间的跟踪。 弗林德斯大学的研究人员使用了骨质疏松性骨折研究的数据。他们反复评估参与者的饮酒习惯，并测量髋部和股骨颈的骨密度，这两个区域与骨折风险密切相关。 在为期 10 年的研究期间，这些女性定期报告她们喝了多少咖啡和茶。研究人员还使用先进的成像方法来监测骨密度的变化。 结果显示，喝茶的女性髋部总骨密度略高于不喝茶的女性。差异很小，但具有统计显着性，并且在考虑到大量人群时仍然很重要。 医学与公共卫生学院的兼职副教授 Enwu Liu 表示：“即使骨密度的微小改善也可以减少大群体的骨折。” 咖啡呈现出更复杂的模式。适量饮酒（每天约两到三杯）不会对骨骼健康造成损害。然而，每天喝五杯以上的女性的骨密度较低，这表明大量喝咖啡可能会产生负面影响。 这种关系似乎也因其他健康和生活方式因素而异。终生饮酒量较高的女性与咖啡相关的负面影响更强，而茶的明显益处在肥胖女性中更为明显。 该论文的合著者 Ryan Liu 表示，茶叶中富含儿茶素，可能会促进骨骼形成并减缓骨骼分解。 “相比之下，实验室研究表明，咖啡中的咖啡因含量会干扰钙吸收和骨代谢，尽管这些影响很小，可以通过添加牛奶来抵消，”弗林德斯大学的 Ryan Liu 说。 兼职副教授刘恩武补充说，研究结果表明，经常喝茶可以提供一种支持骨骼健康的简单方法......

reflection.en: The study highlights how daily habits can impact our physical well-being, particularly bone health in older women. It prompts us to consider our bodies as intricate creations, wonderfully made and deserving of care. As we navigate lifestyle choices, we can reflect on the Psalmist's awe at being "fearfully and wonderfully made," recognizing the delicate...
reflection.zh: 这项研究强调了日常习惯如何影响我们的身体健康，尤其是在老年女性的骨骼健康方面。它促使我们思考，我们的身体是奇妙的受造之物，值得我们去呵护。在我们做出生活方式的选择时，可以反思诗篇作者对“我被造，奇妙可畏”的惊叹，认识到我们身体内部精妙的平衡。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

Using publicly available data from 2006-2023, the study, which was commissioned by Pesticide Action Network , found there to be an estimated 402-433m cases of unintentional acute pesticide poisoning of farmers and farm workers every year. Their plight often goes unnoticed, a silent crisis affecting those who feed the world. We are called to lend our voices to their cause, advocating for safer conditions and greater protection for these...
reflection.zh: 这项研究描绘了数百万农民日常现实的严峻景象，他们面临着使用以维持我们生计的工具所带来的严重健康风险。他们的困境常常被忽视，这是一场影响着养活世界的人们的无声危机。我们被呼召为他们的事业发声，倡导更安全的环境和为这些重要的劳动者提供更大的保护。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: A search for one exotic particle uncovered two strange new structures
title.zh: 寻找一种奇异粒子意外发现了两种奇怪的新结构

summary.en: A search for one mysterious particle unexpectedly revealed evidence for two different structures that may belong to the bizarre family of exotic subatomic particles known as XYZ states. The findings could help physicists uncover new ways that quarks and gluons combine to create...
summary.zh: 一项对一种神秘粒子的搜寻意外地揭示了两种不同结构的证据，它们可能属于被称为XYZ态的奇异亚原子粒子家族。这些发现可能有助于物理学家揭示夸克和胶子结合产生...的新方式。

body.en:
Physicists have spent decades organizing the growing collection of subatomic particles, yet some discoveries continue to resist easy classification. Researchers at the U.S. Department of Energy's Thomas Jefferson National Accelerator Facility have now identified evidence for two unexpected structures that may help clarify part of this increasingly complicated particle landscape.

The signals could shed light on a puzzling group of objects known as XYZ states. These states do not fit neatly into the conventional picture of particles built from quarks, the fundamental building blocks of matter. For the first time, Jefferson Lab researchers detected two such signals created when a beam of high-energy photons interacted with a proton target.

The findings come from the Gluonic Excitations (GlueX) Collaboration in Experimental Hall D at Jefferson Lab and were recently published in Physical Review Letters . The results could help scientists better understand how one of nature's fundamental forces contributes to the formation of matter.

"We went searching for a confirmed XYZ candidate with a photon beam but instead found two other structures," said Malte Albrecht, a staff scientist at Jefferson Lab. "It's new information."

Beginning in the 1950s, high-energy collision experiments started revealing large numbers of subatomic particles collectively known as hadrons. Hadrons are composite particles containing two or more quarks held together by the strong nuclear force. Familiar examples include protons and neutrons, which each contain three quarks (though they had already been identified decades earlier).

Among the newly discovered hadrons were short-lived particles called mesons. These typically consist of a quark paired with its antimatter counterpart, the antiquark. In 1964, physicists introduced the quark model to organize these bound states. The earliest version contained three quark "flavors": up, down and strange. Up and down quarks, for example, are the ingredients that form protons and neutrons. Up, down and strange are also the three lightest types of quarks.

Particle physics changed dramatically again in 1974 with the discovery of the heavier charm quark. The quark model was eventually expanded to include six flavors. The charm quark discovery helped build the framework that became the Standard Model, the broad theory describing elementary particles and fundamental forces, while also expanding the known spectrum of possible hadronic structures.

As particle accelerators became more powerful and detectors grew increasingly sensitive, researchers gained access to subtler physical processes. After the start of the 21st century, experiments began revealing many hadrons with unusual quantum properties that did not fit comfortably within the...
body.zh: 物理学家花了几十年的时间来组织不断增长的亚原子粒子集合，但一些发现仍然难以简单分类。美国能源部托马斯·杰斐逊国家加速器设施的研究人员现已发现了两种意想不到的结构的证据，这可能有助于澄清这一日益复杂的粒子景观的一部分。 这些信号可以揭示一组令人费解的物体，即 XYZ 态。这些状态并不完全符合由夸克构成的粒子的传统图像，夸克是物质的基本组成部分。杰斐逊实验室的研究人员首次检测到当高能光子束与质子目标相互作用时产生的两个此类信号。 该研究结果来自杰斐逊实验室 D 实验厅的糖激发 (GlueX) 合作，最近发表在《物理评论快报》上。这些结果可以帮助科学家更好地了解自然界的基本力量之一如何促进物质的形成。 杰斐逊实验室的科学家马尔特·阿尔布雷希特 (Malte Albrecht) 表示：“我们用光子束寻找已确认的 XYZ 候选结构，但却发现了另外两个结构。” “这是新信息。” 从 20 世纪 50 年代开始，高能碰撞实验开始揭示出大量统称为强子的亚原子粒子。强子是包含两个或多个通过强核力结合在一起的夸克的复合粒子。熟悉的例子包括质子和中子，它们各自包含三个夸克（尽管它们在几十年前就已经被识别出来）。 新发现的强子中有一种称为介子的短寿命粒子。它们通常由夸克与其反物质对应物（反夸克）配对组成。 1964年，物理学家引入夸克模型来组织这些束缚态。最早的版本包含三种夸克“风味”：上夸克、下夸克和奇异夸克。例如，上夸克和下夸克是形成质子和中子的成分。上夸克、下夸克和奇异夸克也是最轻的三种夸克。 1974 年，随着更重的粲夸克的发现，粒子物理学再次发生了巨大的变化。夸克模型最终扩展到包括六种风味。粲夸克的发现帮助建立了后来成为标准模型的框架，这是描述基本粒子和基本力的广泛理论，同时也扩展了可能的强子结构的已知谱。 随着粒子加速器变得越来越强大，探测器变得越来越灵敏，研究人员能够了解更微妙的物理过程。进入 21 世纪后，实验开始揭示出许多具有不寻常量子特性的强子，这些特性并不适合......

reflection.en: The universe, from the grandest galaxies to the smallest subatomic particles, consistently reveals wonders that point beyond themselves. Even in the pursuit of one specific discovery, physicists at Jefferson Lab found evidence for two new structures. This reminds us that creation is a rich text, offering insights into its Creator's wisdom and power when we...
reflection.zh: 宇宙从最宏伟的星系到最小的亚原子粒子，不断揭示着指向其自身的奇迹。即使在追求一项特定发现的过程中，杰斐逊实验室的物理学家也发现了两种新结构的证据。这提醒我们，创造是丰富文本，当我们以好奇和谦卑的态度观察它时，它会提供关于其创造者智慧和力量的见解。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Watch: Astronauts set out on rare all-female spacewalk
title.zh: 观看：宇航员进行罕见的首次全女性太空行走

summary.en: For the sixth time in history, a team of two women completed a spacewalk outside the International Space Station.
summary.zh: 历史上第六次，一支由两名女性组成的团队完成了在国际空间站外的太空行走。

body.en:
For the sixth time in history, a team of two women completed a spacewalk outside the International Space Station.

Nasa astronaut Jessica Meir and French astronaut Sophie Adenot suited up for a 6.5-hour spacewalk. Meir rode the station’s Canadarm2 robotic arm to the worksites, while Adenot remained tethered to the station.

Meir previously made history in 2019 when she and Nasa astronaut Christina Koch completed the first ever all-female spacewalk.

This event marked the 284th spacewalk in support of space station assembly, maintenance and upgrades, and the seventh spacewalk of the year.
body.zh: 由两名女性组成的团队历史上第六次在国际空间站外完成了太空行走。 美国宇航局宇航员杰西卡·梅尔和法国宇航员索菲·阿德诺特准备好进行 6.5 小时的太空行走。梅尔乘坐空间站的 Canadaarm2 机械臂前往工作地点，而阿德诺则仍被拴在空间站上。 梅尔曾在 2019 年创造历史，当时她和美国宇航局宇航员克里斯蒂娜·科赫完成了有史以来第一次全女性太空行走。 此次活动是支持空间站组装、维护和升级的第284次太空行走，也是今年的第七次太空行走。

reflection.en: The successful completion of this spacewalk by two women is a testament to human ingenuity and the incredible capabilities of the human body and mind. It reminds us of the Psalmist's awe at creation, recognizing that we are fearfully and wonderfully made, capable of extraordinary feats when we apply ourselves. This achievement, the sixth all-female...
reflection.zh: 这两名女性成功完成此次太空行走，是人类智慧以及人体和心灵非凡能力的证明。它让我们想起诗篇作者对受造物的惊叹，认识到我们是受造奇妙，当我们投入其中时，能够完成非凡的壮举。 这一成就，是历史上第六次全女性太空行走，突显了当障碍被消除，个人被赋权去探索人类事业的边界时，所能释放出的潜力。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: 'We'll find way to save Jodrell Bank,' Burnham says
title.zh: 伯纳姆表示“我们将找到拯救乔德雷尔银行的方法”

summary.en: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has pledged to save the UK's largest telescope at the Jodrell Bank Observatory, known as the Lovell telescope, which has been in place since 1957. The observatory faces potential funding cuts after March 2028, as UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) will not prioritize it for further funding....
summary.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆承诺将拯救位于乔德雷尔银行天文台的英国最大的望远镜，即自1957年以来一直存在的洛厄尔望远镜。由于英国研究与创新署（UKRI）将不再优先考虑为其提供进一步资助，该天文台在2028年3月后将面临潜在的资金削减。伯纳姆表示，他坚决致力于保护该基地，并提及其文化意义。

body.en:
Prime Minister Andy Burnham has vowed to save the UK's largest telescope at the Jodrell Bank Observatory.

The Lovell telescope, which has stood in Cheshire since 1957, is the world's third-largest steerable radio telescope.

But in July this year, UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) said the site would not be prioritised for further funding after its current agreement ended in March 2028.

Burnham said: "Every one of my generation went on a school trip to Jodrell Bank, and there is no way that we can see its demise, and it won't happen under my government."

UKRI said its decision for the site was "the result of a comprehensive, evidence-based prioritisation process".

The Prime Minister spoke of his determination to save the site after being asked a question about its future in the House of Commons.

Congleton MP Sarah Russell, whose constituency includes the Jodrell Bank site, said it "is facing a significant problem in the medium term because of funding cuts".

She called on Burnham and No 10 North to work alongside her and Macclesfield MP Tim Roca to address the issue.

Burnham said: "I know there are changes that have been made in relation to research funding, but Jodrell Bank is a heritage asset for the country, as well as a research asset."

He said he would set up the meeting she requested, adding: "There must be a way to save Jodrell Bank, and I give a commitment today, at this despatch box, we will find it."

The Jodrell Bank site was first established in 1945 and pioneered radio astronomy and the study of galaxies beyond our own.

The site has also been immortalised in popular science fiction productions from the Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy to Doctor Who.

Scientists have described the UKRI's decision as "heartbreaking" and "scientifically misguided".

More than 150 public figures have signed a letter calling for the government to reverse its decision and "find funding immediately to save Jodrell Bank".

Signatories include astronaut Tim Peake, musicians Sir Brian May, Johnny Marr and Jarvis Cocker, the bands New Order, Elbow and Doves and comedian Dara Ó Briain.

Scotland's Astronomer Royal Prof Catherine Heymans, physicists Prof Jim Al-Khalili and Prof Brian Cox, and Judy Spence, the daughter of the site's founder Sir Bernard Lovell, have also signed it.

All scientific observations at Jodrell are expected to cease on the 1 April 2028 unless alternative funding can be found.

The Lovell Telescope has a diameter of 250ft (76.2m) and is part of the e-Merlin array, a network of telescopes up and down the country that is operated by the University of Manchester from the site.

Its work in tracking spacecraft in the early space race, and its research into quasars, pulsars and gravitational lenses, is also part of its outstanding...
body.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆发誓要拯救位于乔德雷尔班克天文台的英国最大望远镜。 洛弗尔望远镜自 1957 年以来一直矗立在柴郡，是世界第三大可操纵射电望远镜。 但今年 7 月，英国研究与创新 (UKRI) 表示，在当前协议于 2028 年 3 月结束后，该网站将不会优先获得进一步资助。 伯纳姆说：“我们这一代人都曾去乔德雷尔银行进行学校旅行，我们不可能看到它的消亡，而且在我的政府领导下，这种情况也不会发生。” UKRI 表示，该网站的决定是“全面、基于证据的优先顺序流程的结果”。 在下议院被问及有关该遗址未来的问题后，首相谈到了他拯救该遗址的决心。 康格尔顿议员莎拉·拉塞尔（其选区包括乔德雷尔银行网站）表示，“由于资金削减，该银行在中期面临着重大问题”。 她呼吁伯纳姆和北十号与她和麦克尔斯菲尔德议员蒂姆·罗卡一起解决这个问题。 伯纳姆说：“我知道研究经费方面已经发生了一些变化，但乔德雷尔银行是国家的遗产资产，也是研究资产。” 他说他会安排她要求的会面，并补充道：“一定有办法拯救乔德雷尔银行，我今天承诺，在这个快递箱里，我们会找到它。” Jodrell Bank 站点始建于 1945 年，开创了射电天文学和太阳系外星系的研究。 该网站还出现在《银河系漫游指南》和《神秘博士》等流行科幻小说中。 科学家们将 UKRI 的决定描述为“令人心碎”和“科学上的误导”。 超过 150 名公众人物签署了一封信，呼吁政府改变决定并“立即寻找资金来拯救 Jodrell 银行”。 签名者包括宇航员蒂姆·皮克、音乐家布莱恩·梅爵士、约翰尼·马尔和贾维斯·科克、New Order、Elbow 和 Doves 乐队以及喜剧演员达拉·奥·布莱恩。 苏格兰皇家天文学家凯瑟琳·海曼斯教授、物理学家吉姆·阿尔哈利利教授和布莱恩·考克斯教授以及该网站创始人伯纳德·洛弗尔爵士的女儿朱迪·斯彭斯也签署了该协议。 除非找到替代资金，否则 Jodrell 的所有科学观测预计将于 2028 年 4 月 1 日停止。 洛弗尔望远镜直径为 250 英尺（76.2 m），是 e-Merlin 阵列的一部分，e-Merlin 阵列是由曼彻斯特大学在该站点运营的遍布全国的望远镜网络。 它在早期太空竞赛中跟踪航天器的工作，以及对类星体、脉冲星和引力透镜的研究，也是其杰出成就的一部分……

reflection.en: The Lovell telescope at Jodrell Bank has for decades turned humanity's gaze toward the stars, a testament to our innate curiosity about the cosmos. The heavens, in their vastness and order, have always spoken of a grandeur beyond our own. As efforts are made to preserve this instrument of observation, we are reminded that the universe itself is a testament...
reflection.zh: 乔德雷尔银行的洛厄尔望远镜几十年来一直将人类的目光引向星空，证明了我们对宇宙与生俱来的好奇心。天空以其浩瀚和秩序，总是诉说着超越我们自身的宏伟。当我们努力保护这一观测工具时，我们被提醒，宇宙本身就是其创造者荣耀的见证。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Could humans ever communicate with whales? - video
title.zh: 人类能否与鲸鱼交流？- 视频

summary.en: Since the first recording of whale song in 1949, researchers have been fascinated by their complex vocalizations. As technology advances, scientists are deciphering these intricate patterns to better understand and protect whales from human-caused harm.
summary.zh: 自1949年首次录制鲸鱼歌声以来，研究人员一直被它们复杂的发声所吸引。随着技术的进步，科学家们正在破译这些复杂的模式，以更好地理解并保护鲸鱼免受人类的伤害。

body.en: Ever since the earliest known recording of whale song was made in 1949 , researchers have been captivated by the wails, rumbles, clicks, grunts and squeals of their communication. As technology improves, scientists are decoding the intricate patterns that make different species’ vocalisations distinctive. Madeleine Finlay hears from Emma Bryce, a journalist who has spent months investigating human efforts to understand whale song. She explains how this knowledge could help us better protect whales from human-made harms. Credits: 1. Valeria Vergara/Raincoast Conservation Foundation 2. Footage courtesy of Raincoast Conservation Foundation - Obtained for research under SARA permit XMMS 4 2026 3. Video by Amanda Cotton/Project CETI 4. Footage courtesy of Valeria Vergara and GREMM. Obtained for research under SARA permits QUE-MM02-2016 and QUE-LEP-001-2018 5. Project CETI 6. Project CETI Continue reading...
body.zh: 自从 1949 年录制了已知最早的鲸鱼歌声以来，研究人员就一直被它们交流时的哀号、隆隆声、咔哒声、咕噜声和尖叫声所吸引。随着技术的进步，科学家们正在破译使不同物种的发声与众不同的复杂模式。马德琳·芬利听到艾玛·布莱斯的来信，她是一名记者，花了几个月的时间调查人类理解鲸鱼歌曲的努力。她解释了这些知识如何帮助我们更好地保护鲸鱼免受人为伤害。鸣谢： 1. Valeria Vergara/Raincoast 保护基金会 2. 影片由 Raincoast 保护基金会提供 - 根据 SARA 许可 XMMS 4 2026 获得用于研究 3. 视频由 Amanda Cotton/Project CETI 提供 4. 影片由 Valeria Vergara 和 GREMM 提供。根据 SARA 许可证 QUE-MM02-2016 和 QUE-LEP-001-2018 获得研究 5. CETI 项目 6. CETI 项目 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The deep sea holds mysteries, and the complex songs of whales are one of them. For decades, humans have listened, trying to understand. This pursuit of knowledge about creation mirrors the ancient truth that the heavens and earth declare the glory and wisdom of Yahweh, inviting us to observe and learn.
reflection.zh: 深海充满了奥秘，鲸鱼复杂的歌声便是其中之一。几十年来，人类一直在倾听，试图理解。这种对受造之物的求知欲，恰恰映照了古老的真理：诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，穹苍传扬祂的作为，邀请我们观察和学习。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: ‘Superhuman’ AI tool spots heart disease in less than 2 seconds
title.zh: “超人”人工智能工具2秒内发现心脏病

summary.en: A new AI tool, trained on millions of routine ECGs, can detect heart disease in under two seconds by analyzing data beyond human visual capacity. This technology aims to expedite treatment for high-risk patients, potentially reducing the need for lengthy waits for echocardiograms.
summary.zh: 一款新的人工智能工具，通过对数百万份常规心电图进行训练，能在两秒内发现心脏病，其分析能力超越了人眼所能见的范畴。该技术旨在加快高风险患者的治疗进程，并可能减少对需要长时间等待的超声心动图检查的依赖。

body.en:
Doctors have developed a “superhuman” AI tool that can spot heart disease in less than two seconds.

The groundbreaking technology has been trained on millions of patients and works by extracting more information from a routine electrocardiogram (ECG) than the human eye can typically see.

The traditional ECG, which records electrical activity in the heart, including the rate and rhythm, has been a vital medical tool in diagnosing heart attacks and abnormal heart rhythms for a century.

But it cannot detect heart disease. That requires an echocardiogram, a type of ultrasound scan, which patients often have to wait months for.

Now a team have developed an AI tool that can spot signs of heart failure and heart valve disease – two of the most common forms of heart disease – from ECG results in “the blink of an eye”.

Details of the breakthrough, which could boost early diagnosis of heart disease, were presented to thousands of delegates at the European Society of Cardiology annual congress in Munich, the world’s largest heart conference.

Early diagnosis is vital for heart failure and heart valve disease, enabling those who need lifesaving medicines to be spotted sooner, before they become dangerously unwell.

The development is being seen as potentially significant, because ECGs are one of the most common tests in medicine, with about a billion performed worldwide each year.

In a trial involving 67,000 patients in the US, the AI tool was able to identify up to 81% of those who had heart failure, and up to 90% of those with heart valve disease.

Dr Sonya Babu-Narayan, a consultant cardiologist and clinical director of the British Heart Foundation (BHF), which funded the trial, said: “It is exciting to see that AI can now deliver a read-out from an ECG in what feels like the blink of an eye.

“Technology like the AI ECG in this research, which has the potential to identify high-risk patients early, will not detect everyone with a heart condition. But it could be a solution to help fast-track the patients who are most likely to have a heart abnormality. When it comes to the heart, earlier diagnosis and treatment saves and improves lives.”

The tech cannot be used on its own to definitively diagnose or rule out heart failure or heart valve disease, but it gives a very strong indication someone may have them.

Someone judged as highly likely to have either could be sent rapidly for an echocardiogram, rather than wait months on the standard waiting lists. That could mean a quicker diagnosis which would enable them to start treatment earlier.

Prof Fu Siong Ng, a professor of cardiology at Imperial College London, said: “Patients can often wait several months for a heart ultrasound scan after being referred for one by their doctor.

“This makes it exciting...
body.zh: 医生们开发出了一种“超人”的人工智能工具，可以在不到两秒的时间内发现心脏病。 这项突破性的技术已经在数百万患者身上进行了培训，其工作原理是从常规心电图 (ECG) 中提取比人眼通常可以看到的更多信息。 传统的心电图记录心脏的电活动，包括心率和节律，一个世纪以来一直是诊断心脏病和心律失常的重要医疗工具。 但它无法检测心脏病。这需要超声心动图（一种超声波扫描），患者通常需要等待数月。 现在，一个团队开发了一种人工智能工具，可以根据“眨眼间”的心电图结果发现心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病（两种最常见的心脏病形式）的迹象。 这一突破的细节可以促进心脏病的早期诊断，在慕尼黑举行的欧洲心脏病学会年会上向数千名代表介绍了这一突破，这是世界上最大的心脏病会议。 早期诊断对于心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病至关重要，使那些需要救生药物的人能够在出现危险的不适之前尽早发现。 这一发展被认为具有潜在的重大意义，因为心电图是医学中最常见的测试之一，全世界每年进行约十亿次。 在美国一项涉及 67,000 名患者的试验中，AI 工具能够识别出高达 81% 的心力衰竭患者和高达 90% 的心脏瓣膜疾病患者。 资助这项试验的英国心脏基金会 (BHF) 的心脏病专家兼临床主任索尼娅·巴布-纳拉扬 (Sonya Babu-Narayan) 博士表示：“令人兴奋的是，人工智能现在可以在眨眼的时间内读取心电图读数。 “这项研究中的人工智能心电图等技术有可能及早识别出高危患者，但无法检测出每个患有心脏病的人。但这可能是帮助快速追踪最有可能患有心脏异常的患者的解决方案。当涉及到心脏时，早期诊断和治疗可以挽救并改善生命。” 该技术不能单独用于明确诊断或排除心力衰竭或心脏瓣膜疾病，但它给出了一个非常强烈的迹象，表明某人可能患有这些疾病。 被判断为极有可能患有这两种疾病的人可以被迅速送去做超声心动图检查，而不是在标准等待名单上等待数月。这可能意味着更快的诊断，使他们能够更早地开始治疗。 伦敦帝国理工学院心脏病学教授 Fu Siong Ng 教授表示：“在医生推荐进行心脏超声扫描后，患者通常需要等待几个月才能进行心脏超声扫描。 “这让人兴奋......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in this new tool's ability to diagnose heart disease, reflects a world where human knowledge and technical capabilities are accelerating. As we witness such profound leaps in understanding and application, we are reminded of the biblical observation that in the end times, 'many will run to and fro,...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如这款能诊断心脏病的工具所示，反映了一个人类知识和技术能力日益加速的世界。当我们见证理解和应用上的巨大飞跃时，我们不禁想起圣经中的观察——在末世，“许多人往来奔跑，知识也必增长”。这种技术进步为治疗和福祉带来了巨大的潜力，呼唤我们以智慧和怜悯之心来管理它。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Smelling test: children need education in sniffing aromas, scientist says
title.zh: 闻香识人：科学家称儿童需要嗅觉教育

summary.en: Dr. Will Tullett, a historian of smells, argues that children need better education in understanding aromas, which can enhance their wellbeing and perception of the world. He notes that pollution can impair olfactory abilities and that many modern products are stripped of natural scents and replaced with synthetic...
summary.zh: 气味历史学家威尔·塔利特博士认为，儿童需要更好地学习理解香气，这可以提高他们的幸福感和对世界的感知能力。他指出，污染会损害嗅觉能力，而许多现代产品都失去了原有的气味，并被合成了。

body.en: Exclusive: Dr Will Tullett says better understanding of scents can improve wellbeing and perception of the world Children need a better education in sniffing aromas, a leading historian of smells has said, noting it may improve their wellbeing and help them understand the world around them. Dr Will Tullett, of the University of York, said pollution had been found to impair people’s olfactory abilities, while many objects and substances today – from margarines to car interiors and even our own homes – were stripped of their original smells and “reodourised” with synthetic scents. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家报道：威尔·塔利特博士表示，更好地理解气味可以改善幸福感和对世界的感知 一位著名的气味历史学家表示，孩子们需要接受更好的嗅香教育，并指出这可能会改善他们的幸福感并帮助他们了解周围的世界。约克大学的威尔·塔利特博士表示，污染已被发现会损害人们的嗅觉能力，而今天的许多物体和物质——从人造黄油到汽车内饰，甚至我们自己的家——都失去了原来的气味，并用合成气味“重新散发”气味。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Dr. Will Tullett's work reminds us that even the sense of smell, often overlooked, is a gift from our Creator. Just as the heavens declare God's glory, so too can the intricate world of scents offer us wonder and deeper perception. Paying attention to the aromas around us, whether natural or synthetic, can be an act of mindful engagement with the world...
reflection.zh: 威尔·塔利特博士的工作提醒我们，即使是常常被忽视的嗅觉，也是我们造物主的恩赐。正如诸天述说雅伟的荣耀一样，气味的复杂世界也能带给我们惊奇和更深的感知。留意我们周围的气味，无论是天然的还是合成的，都可以成为一种有意识地与雅伟所造世界互动的方式。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Space junk punched a new hole in the moon. It’s not ours to abuse | Moriba Jah
title.zh: 太空垃圾在月球上打了个新洞。它不是我们可随意糟蹋的。

summary.en: The space industry often treats orbit as a dumping ground for unwanted materials. A piece of a defunct SpaceX rocket impacted the moon on August 5th, creating a new crater. While astronomers noted the resulting plume of sodium and lithium, the incident highlights a lack of accountability for space debris, prompting...
summary.zh: 太空行业常常将轨道视为废弃物的倾倒场。8月5日，一枚报废的SpaceX火箭残骸撞击月球，形成了一个新陨石坑。天文学家观测到了由此产生的钠和锂的喷发物，但此次事件凸显了太空垃圾缺乏问责制的问题，并呼吁建立新的责任模式。

body.en: The space industry treats the sky as a place to dump what it no longer wants. We must develop a new model of accountability On 5 August, a piece of a derelict SpaceX rocket traveling at 5,400 miles an hour met with the moon and punched a fresh hole into it near Einstein Crater . Astronomers were thrilled. The European Southern Observatory caught sodium and lithium flaring in the debris plume and called it a bonus. The media called it a light show. Nobody was physically hurt, so nobody is responsible, and within a week the story was gone. I have spent 20 years tracking the junk humanity leaves behind in space for a living, and I want to tell you plainly what that crater actually is: a receipt. It’s what you get when an entire industry treats the sky, and now the moon, as a place to dump what it no longer wants, and calls the dumping “normal operations” or “space exploration”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 航天工业将天空视为倾倒不再想要的东西的地方。我们必须制定新的问责模式 8 月 5 日，一枚废弃 SpaceX 火箭的一块碎片以每小时 5,400 英里的速度与月球相遇，并在爱因斯坦陨石坑附近的月球上砸出了一个新的洞。天文学家们兴奋不已。欧洲南方天文台在碎片羽流中发现了钠和锂的燃烧，并将其称为额外奖励。媒体称其为灯光秀。没有人受到身体伤害，所以没有人负责，一周之内这个故事就消失了。我花了 20 年的时间追踪人类在太空中留下的垃圾为生，我想清楚地告诉你那个陨石坑实际上是什么：一张收据。当整个行业将天空和现在的月球视为倾倒不再想要的东西的地方，并将倾倒称为“正常操作”或“太空探索”时，你就会得到这样的结果。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The author calls the crater a 'receipt' for humanity's careless disposal of space junk. This incident prompts reflection on our stewardship of creation, not just on Earth, but in the vastness of space. Genesis 1:31 declares all of creation 'very good,' implying a divine mandate to care for and protect it, rather than exploit or defile it.
reflection.zh: 作者将这个陨石坑称为人类随意丢弃太空垃圾的“收据”。这一事件促使我们反思对受造界的管理责任，不仅是在地球上，也包括浩瀚的太空。《创世记》1章31节宣告万物“甚好”，暗示了神圣的使命是去关爱和保护它，而不是剥削或玷污它。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: Uber launches UK's first robotaxis with a driver - here's what it's like to ride in one
title.zh: 优步推出英国首款带司机的机器人出租车——乘坐体验如何

summary.en: The ride-hailing app has launched 15 self-driving taxis, but they will have safety drivers inside.
summary.zh: 网约车应用已推出15辆自动驾驶出租车，但车内配有安全员。

body.en:
Londoners are able to hail the UK's first robotaxis - as Uber today becomes the first company to launch a self-driving minicab.

Initially, it only has 15 autonomous vehicles with a licence to operate in the city, and each one must have a human safety driver behind the wheel ready to take control if anything goes wrong.

Uber said it surveyed London-based customers via the app and more than 100,000 said they would choose a self-driving taxi if one was available, despite incidents of driverless rides malfunctioning in US cities where they already operate.

As I found out when I became the first UK journalist to hail one, it was mostly smooth but the safety driver did intervene on one occasion.

At the moment the UK fare for a robotaxi ride will be the same fare as a standard UberX, Uber Electric, or Uber Comfort journey, with upfront fares shown in the app.

Taking a self-driving ride will only appear as an option in the app after the journey has been booked, and if one of its cars is available nearby.

Uber's global head of autonomous mobility and delivery Sarfraz Maredia said the plan was to phase them in over a period of several years.

"We always want consumers to be able to request a human ride or an autonomous vehicle, and because the market's growing, we expect that there will be human drivers on Uber London for a long time to come," he said.

The Ford Mustang electric vehicles which make up Uber's current small fleet are fitted with the UK tech firm Wayve's driverless car technology, which uses AI to analyse data about what is going on around it in real time, gathered by sensors in a bar on the roof of the vehicle and elsewhere.

The vehicles are not pre-programmed - their actions are determined on the spot depending on what is going on.

Google's autonomous car company Waymo and the Chinese tech giant Baidu are also vying to launch services in the UK, and the competition is fierce.

Wayve chief executive Alex Kendall described developing the technology as "the space race for our generation" but added there were some "really hard problems to solve" along the way.

"What we've done over time is pioneer a completely new approach to autonomous driving, making it possible to bring this to a busy and complex city like London and scale it globally," he said.

This week I became the first British journalist to travel as a customer in a self-driving Uber after hailing one via the app.

The safety driver gave me a 30-second safety briefing, and then we were off, making our way down the busy streets of central London.

For several minutes, we negotiated the traffic without incident, cruising past a busy Brexit demonstration underway outside parliament, successfully navigating traffic lights and roadworks along the way.

When a cyclist paused and waved...
body.zh: 伦敦人可以欢呼英国第一辆机器人出租车——优步今天成为第一家推出自动驾驶小型出租车的公司。 最初，它只有 15 辆拥有在该市运营许可证的自动驾驶汽车，每辆汽车都必须配备一名人类安全驾驶员，随时准备在出现问题时接管控制。 Uber 表示，它通过该应用程序对伦敦的客户进行了调查，超过 10 万名客户表示，如果有自动驾驶出租车，他们会选择自动驾驶出租车，尽管他们已经在美国城市运营的无人驾驶出租车出现了故障。 当我成为第一个向安全司机欢呼的英国记者时发现，一切都很顺利，但安全司机确实有一次进行了干预。 目前，英国机器人出租车的票价将与标准 UberX、Uber Electric 或 Uber Comfort 旅程的票价相同，预付费用会显示在应用程序中。 只有在预订行程后，并且附近有一辆自驾车辆可用时，乘坐自驾游才会作为一个选项出现在应用程序中。 Uber 自动驾驶移动和配送全球主管 Sarfraz Maredia 表示，该计划将在几年内分阶段实施。 他说：“我们一直希望消费者能够要求有人乘坐或自动驾驶汽车，而且由于市场不断增长，我们预计 Uber London 将在未来很长一段时间内有人类司机。” 构成 Uber 目前小型车队的福特野马电动汽车配备了英国科技公司 Wayve 的无人驾驶汽车技术，该技术使用人工智能来实时分析周围发生的情况的数据，这些数据由车辆顶部酒吧和其他地方的传感器收集。 这些车辆没有预先编程——它们的行动是根据发生的情况当场决定的。 谷歌旗下自动驾驶汽车公司Waymo和中国科技巨头百度也竞相在英国推出服务，竞争非常激烈。 Wayve 首席执行官亚历克斯·肯德尔 (Alex Kendall) 将开发这项技术描述为“我们这一代人的太空竞赛”，但他补充说，在此过程中存在一些“真正难以解决的问题”。 他说：“随着时间的推移，我们所做的是开创一种全新的自动驾驶方法，使其能够将其引入伦敦这样繁忙而复杂的城市，并在全球范围内推广。” 本周，我通过应用程序叫了一辆自动驾驶优步车，成为第一位乘坐自动驾驶优步车出行的英国记者。 安全司机给我做了 30 秒的安全简报，然后我们就出发了，沿着伦敦市中心繁忙的街道行驶。 在几分钟的时间里，我们顺利通过了交通，驶过议会外正在进行的繁忙的脱欧示威活动，成功地通过了沿途的红绿灯和道路施工。 当一个骑自行车的人停下来挥手时......

reflection.en: Uber's introduction of robotaxis in London, even with safety drivers, marks a significant step in autonomous vehicle technology. As this new venture unfolds, the company and its employees might consider committing their efforts and plans to Yahweh, trusting in His guidance for success and safety in this innovative endeavor. May their work be guided by...
reflection.zh: 优步在伦敦推出机器人出租车，即使配备安全员，也标志着自动驾驶技术的重要一步。随着这项新事业的展开，公司及其员工或许会考虑将他们的努力和计划交托给雅伟，信靠祂的指引，以期在这项创新事业中取得成功和安全。愿他们的工作以智慧为指导，并致力于为公众提供良好服务。

title.en: Spending deal comes with a bonus: Blocking political control of grants
title.zh: 支出协议附带一项奖励：阻止对资助的政治控制

summary.en: Congress pauses the OMB's attempt to rewrite how research is funded.
summary.zh: 国会暂停了行政管理和预算局（OMB）试图改写研究资助方式的举动。

body.en: On Tuesday, the House of Representatives passed a stopgap measure that would continue funding the US government through early December. While the measure still requires the signature of President Trump, it's widely expected that he will act to avoid a government shutdown immediately before the midterm elections. This is a normal part of how the US government has operated in recent years, as it's often difficult to build the political support needed to pass a full year's budget in advance. In fact, dissent within the House's Republican caucus prevented them from agreeing on their own measure to keep the government open; instead, the House simply adopted a version of the spending bill that had previously passed the Senate. From the perspective of scientists and their supporters, that adoption turned out to be a very good thing. Because the Senate's budget bill, passed in early August , contains a provision that blocks the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) from implementing new rules that would give political appointees full control over what science is funded and allow them to cancel any grant at any time. The proposed rule has been widely decried as catastrophic for science, and it faced widespread opposition from scientific and health-focused organizations. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 周二，众议院通过了一项权宜之计，将继续为美国政府提供资金直至 12 月初。尽管该措施仍需要特朗普总统签署，但人们普遍预计他将在中期选举前采取行动避免政府关门。这是美国政府近年来运作方式的正常部分，因为通常很难获得提前通过全年预算所需的政治支持。事实上，众议院共和党核心小组内部的异议使他们无法就自己保持政府开放的措施达成一致。相反，众议院只是通过了参议院之前通过的支出法案的一个版本。从科学家及其支持者的角度来看，这种采用是一件非常好的事情。因为八月初通过的参议院预算法案包含一项条款，禁止管理和预算办公室 (OMB) 实施新规则，让政治任命者完全控制科学资助项目，并允许他们随时取消任何资助。拟议的规则被广泛谴责为科学灾难，并遭到科学和健康组织的广泛反对。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In the midst of complex legislative maneuvering, Congress has stepped in to halt the Office of Management and Budget's proposed changes to research funding. This pause, driven by a desire to prevent political interference in scientific inquiry, reflects a commitment to principles of fairness and accountability in governance. It reminds us that the pursuit...
reflection.zh: 在复杂的立法博弈中，国会介入阻止了行政管理和预算局（OMB）提出的研究资助方式的改变。这一暂停，源于防止政治干预科学研究的愿望，体现了对公共治理中公平和问责原则的承诺。它提醒我们，在公共生活中追求正义和诚信是一项持续的努力。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Trump administration sides with OpenAI in lawsuit against New York Times
title.zh: 特朗普政府在与纽约时报的诉讼中支持OpenAI

summary.en: The New York Times and other companies are suing OpenAI, alleging that their copyrighted materials were used without permission to train AI systems. The Trump administration has filed a brief supporting OpenAI, arguing for the use of copyrighted works in AI training.
summary.zh: 《纽约时报》和其他公司正在起诉OpenAI，指控其未经许可使用受版权保护的材料来训练人工智能系统。特朗普政府已提交一份简报支持OpenAI，主张在人工智能训练中使用受版权保护的作品。

body.en: The Times and many companies are accusing OpenAI of misusing their material to train AI systems without compensation The Trump administration is supporting OpenAI in ⁠a lawsuit against the New York Times, arguing in favor of the use of copyrighted writing to train artificial intelligence. The Times accuses OpenAI and its largest financial backer, Microsoft, of using millions of newspaper articles without permission to train OpenAI’s popular chatbot. Other newspapers have joined in the suit, first filed in 2023. Continue reading...
body.zh: 《纽约时报》和许多公司指责 OpenAI 滥用其材料来训练人工智能系统，而没有给予任何补偿。特朗普政府在针对《纽约时报》的诉讼中支持 OpenAI，主张使用受版权保护的作品来训练人工智能。 《泰晤士报》指责 OpenAI 及其最大的财务支持者微软未经许可使用数百万篇报纸文章来训练 OpenAI 广受欢迎的聊天机器人。其他报纸也加入了诉讼，该诉讼于 2023 年首次提起。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This legal battle over AI training data touches on fundamental questions of fairness and intellectual property. As technology races ahead, the ancient call to 'act justly and to love mercy' remains a vital compass for navigating complex ethical landscapes. May wisdom guide those seeking to balance innovation with accountability.
reflection.zh: 这场关于人工智能训练数据的法律纠纷触及了公平和知识产权的基本问题。随着科技的飞速发展，‘秉公行义，喜爱怜悯’这古老的呼召，仍然是导航复杂伦理格局的重要指南。愿智慧引导那些寻求在创新与问责之间取得平衡的人们。

title.en: I rented a car, and within hours, my driver's license was for sale
title.zh: 我租了一辆车，几个小时后，我的驾照就被拿去卖了

summary.en: The FBI is reportedly investigating a massive data breach that is unfolding in real time, where a driver's license scanned by a rental car company employee was found for sale on the dark web.
summary.zh: 据报道，联邦调查局正在调查一起大规模数据泄露事件，该事件正在实时发生。一家租车公司员工扫描的驾照出现在暗网上出售。

body.en: Not long ago, I rented an SUV from a well-known car rental company. Within hours of an employee scanning my driver's license, a high-resolution scan of my ID was available for sale on the dark web. An exposé published Tuesday by KrebsOnSecurity reports that my license was one of more than 153 million that were available through Nexus, the name of the new ID theft service. Like other driver's licenses available there—including some belonging to journalist Brian Krebs, his mother, an FBI assistant director, and several security researchers—my license was purported to include multiple image files showing both the front and back of the ID. Besides a basic image scan, the files also captured the images in the infrared and ultraviolet spectrums. Presumably, the additional formats may allow cloned-based counterfeit IDs to pass hologram tests. Growing by the day Besides advertising the availability of driver's licenses, Nexus offered to sell a bevy of other forms of ID. They included: Read full article Comments
body.zh: 不久前，我从一家知名汽车租赁公司租了一辆SUV。在一名员工扫描我的驾驶执照后几个小时内，我身份证的高分辨率扫描件就可以在暗网上出售。 KrebsOnSecurity 周二发布的一份报告称，我的许可证是通过 Nexus（新的身份盗窃服务的名称）获得的超过 1.53 亿个许可证之一。与那里提供的其他驾照一样，其中一些驾照属于记者布莱恩·克雷布斯、他的母亲、联邦调查局助理局长和几名安全研究人员，我的驾照据称包含多个显示身份证正面和背面的图像文件。除了基本图像扫描之外，这些文件还捕获了红外和紫外光谱中的图像。据推测，附加格式可能允许基于克隆的伪造 ID 通过全息图测试。与日俱增 除了宣传驾驶执照的可用性之外，Nexus 还出售一系列其他形式的身份证件。其中包括： 阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: It is deeply unsettling to learn that a simple act like renting a car can lead to one's identity being compromised and sold. This incident underscores how the pursuit of illicit profit can drive individuals to exploit the personal information of others, turning trust into a commodity for sale on the dark web.
reflection.zh: 得知像租车这样简单的行为会导致个人身份信息被泄露和出售，这令人深感不安。这一事件凸显了对非法利润的追逐如何驱使个人剥削他人的个人信息，将信任变成了暗网上待售的商品。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: FCC plans robocall scorecard to grade phone companies on spam call blocking
title.zh: FCC 计划推出机器人电话记分卡，以评估电话公司屏蔽垃圾电话的效果

summary.en: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has announced plans to develop a scorecard system to evaluate the effectiveness of phone companies in blocking illegal spam calls. These scorecards may incorporate data on call-blocking rates, customer complaints, and enforcement actions, potentially assigning providers risk...
summary.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）宣布计划开发一个记分卡系统，以评估电话公司在阻止非法垃圾电话方面的有效性。这些记分卡可能会纳入通话阻止率、客户投诉和执法行动的数据，并可能为提供商分配风险分类或等级。

body.en: The Federal Communications Commission today said it will create a robocall mitigation scorecard to rate phone companies on how effectively they block illegal spam calls. The scorecards could include call-blocking statistics along with data on customer complaints and enforcement actions. The FCC said scorecards could grade providers on a number scale, with letter grades, or by classifying providers as low risk, medium risk, or high risk. "The Scorecard will empower consumers and encourage providers to continue to combat illegal robocalls by providing the public with an assessment of the effectiveness of voice service providers’ efforts to protect consumers from illegal robocalls," the FCC Consumer and Governmental Affairs Bureau said in a public notice . Read full article Comments
body.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会今天表示，将创建一个自动电话缓解记分卡，以评估电话公司拦截非法垃圾电话的有效性。记分卡可以包括呼叫拦截统计数据以及客户投诉和执法行动的数据。 FCC 表示，记分卡可以按数字、字母等级对提供商进行评级，或者将提供商分为低风险、中风险或高风险。 FCC 消费者和政府事务局在一份公告中表示：“记分卡将向公众提供对语音服务提供商保护消费者免受非法机器人电话侵害的努力有效性的评估，从而赋予消费者权力，并鼓励提供商继续打击非法机器人电话。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The FCC's initiative to create a scorecard for phone companies highlights a commitment to accountability in the fight against illegal robocalls. This effort to bring transparency and measurable standards to the industry echoes the call to 'act justly,' ensuring that companies are held to account for their role in protecting consumers from unwanted and...
reflection.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）推出电话公司记分卡的举措，凸显了在打击非法机器人电话方面对问责制的承诺。这项旨在为行业带来透明度和可衡量标准的努力，呼应了‘秉公行义’的呼召，确保公司对其在保护消费者免受不请自来和欺诈电话方面所扮演的角色负责。

title.en: Wary of Artemis IV timeline, NASA is changing lunar spacesuit design
title.zh: 为赶上阿耳忒弥斯四号时间表，NASA正在改变月球宇航服设计

summary.en: NASA is modifying its lunar spacesuit design to prioritize near-term mission requirements, aiming to accelerate its program for human landings on the Moon's South Pole as early as 2028. The agency will collaborate with Axiom Space to develop a simpler 'Sortie Suit' variant for initial missions, focusing on reducing...
summary.zh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）正在调整其月球宇航服的设计，以优先满足近期任务需求，目标是争取不晚于2028年实现载人登陆月球南极。该机构将与Axiom Space合作，为初步任务开发更简单的“短期任务宇航服”变体，重点在于减轻重量、降低复杂性并简化集成。

body.en: NASA has decided to use a simpler spacesuit for its initial missions to the lunar surface, Ars has learned. The agency announced the decision during an internal meeting this week as it seeks to accelerate its program to land humans at the south pole of the Moon as early as 2028. At the direction of Artemis Program Manager Jeremy Parsons, NASA will work with Axiom Space to develop a "Sortie Suit" variant of the planned spacesuit for the lunar surface. Sources said the Sortie Suit will be used for the initial landing missions flown on landers developed both by SpaceX and Blue Origin. Among the goals of the initiative are to lower the mass of the spacesuit, reduce its complexity, and simplify interfaces between the spacesuits and lunar landers. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 据 Ars 获悉，美国宇航局已决定在其首次月球表面任务中使用更简单的宇航服。该机构在本周的内部会议上宣布了这一决定，旨在加快最早于 2028 年将人类登陆月球南极的计划。在阿耳忒弥斯项目经理杰里米·帕森斯的指导下，美国宇航局将与 Axiom Space 合作，开发计划用于月球表面的宇航服的“Sortie Suit”变体。消息人士称，Sortie Suit 将用于 SpaceX 和 Blue Origin 开发的着陆器上执行的初始着陆任务。该计划的目标之一是降低宇航服的质量，降低其复杂性，并简化宇航服和月球着陆器之间的接口。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The Artemis program faces ambitious timelines, prompting NASA to adapt its spacesuit design for immediate mission needs. This adjustment, prioritizing practicality and speed, echoes the wisdom of committing one's endeavors to divine guidance. By entrusting their plans and efforts, they can navigate the complexities and uncertainties inherent in such...
reflection.zh: 阿尔忒弥斯计划面临着雄心勃勃的时间表，促使NASA调整其宇航服设计以满足即时任务需求。这种优先考虑实用性和速度的调整，呼应了将人的工作交托给神指引的智慧。通过信靠他们的计划和努力，他们可以在这些开创性任务固有的复杂性和不确定性中前行，在追求中寻求智慧和恩惠。

verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Google defeats US justice department bid to force ad tech sale
title.zh: 谷歌击败美国司法部要求出售广告技术的诉讼

summary.en: A judge has rejected the US Department of Justice's attempt to force Google to sell its advertising exchange, marking a significant symbolic victory for Google against antitrust enforcers seeking to break up big tech.
summary.zh: 一名法官驳回了美国司法部要求谷歌出售其广告交易平台的诉讼，这是谷歌在反垄断执法者试图拆分大型科技公司之际取得的又一次象征性胜利。

body.en: Judge declines to make Google sell AdX in win for firm against US antitrust enforcers’ attempts to break up big tech Alphabet’s Google escaped a breakup of its advertising technology business on Wednesday, when a judge in Virginia ⁠rejected US antitrust enforcers’ attempt to force a sale of Google’s online advertising exchange. While the ad exchange is a small part of Google’s business, the ruling is the second powerful ⁠symbolic victory against the US Department ⁠of Justice in ​its efforts to force Google to sell assets to address illegal monopolies. Continue reading...
body.zh: 法官拒绝让谷歌出售 AdX，以赢得美国反垄断执法机构试图分拆大型科技公司的胜利。周三，弗吉尼亚州的一名法官驳回了美国反垄断执法机构强制出售谷歌在线广告交易平台的企图，Alphabet 旗下的谷歌逃脱了广告技术业务分拆的命运。虽然广告交易只是谷歌业务的一小部分，但这项裁决是针对美国司法部迫使谷歌出售资产以解决非法垄断问题的第二次强有力的象征性胜利。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the complex world of big tech and antitrust law, the pursuit of justice and fair competition is paramount. This ruling, while a win for Google, underscores the ongoing tension between market dominance and the public good. May we always seek to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh in all our dealings, whether in the courtroom or the...
reflection.zh: 在大型科技公司和反垄断法的复杂世界中，追求公正和公平竞争至关重要。这项裁决虽然是谷歌的胜利，但凸显了市场主导地位与公共利益之间持续存在的紧张关系。愿我们在所有交易中，无论是在法庭还是在市场，都寻求秉持公义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Google releases Gemini 3.8 Flash, its third Flash model in six weeks
title.zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 3.8 Flash，六周内发布的第三款 Flash 模型

summary.en: Google's Pro model updates are seemingly paused, but there's yet another Gemini Flash today.
summary.zh: 谷歌的 Pro 模型更新似乎已暂停，但今天又推出了一款 Gemini Flash。

body.en: Google hasn't released a frontier-level Gemini Pro AI model since early 2026, but it sure loves rolling out new Gemini Flash variants. Today, Google is announcing its third Flash model release in just six weeks , making it more likely that we'll never see the promised Gemini 3.5 Pro. But no matter, says Google, because Gemini 3.8 Flash is its best reasoning and coding model yet. Gemini 3.8 Flash comes in two variations. There's the standard Flash, which Google describes as a "workhorse" model that's good for anything from agentic tasks to software development. Then we have Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, which runs on the same foundations but has been tuned for vulnerability detection and mitigation. For developers, Google has the same pitch as it did for the 3.7 Flash release just a couple of weeks ago. API access to the model is available at an "introductory rate" through the end of the year: $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens. The regular price will be $1.50 / $7.50, but it's likely there will be new models available long before the price changes. Google probably sees the lower prices as a necessity given that other AI labs have recently dropped token pricing to keep increasingly wary businesses engaged with AI tools. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 自 2026 年初以来，谷歌一直没有发布前沿级的 Gemini Pro AI 模型，但它确实喜欢推出新的 Gemini Flash 变体。今天，谷歌宣布在短短六周内发布第三个 Flash 型号，这使得我们很有可能永远看不到承诺的 Gemini 3.5 Pro。但谷歌表示，没关系，因为 Gemini 3.8 Flash 是迄今为止最好的推理和编码模型。 Gemini 3.8 Flash 有两种版本。有标准的Flash，谷歌将其描述为“主力”模型，适用于从代理任务到软件开发的任何事物。然后我们有 Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber​​，它运行在相同的基础上，但针对漏洞检测和缓解进行了调整。对于开发者来说，谷歌的宣传与几周前发布的 3.7 Flash 版本相同。到今年年底，该模型的 API 访问将以“入门费率”提供：每百万个输入代币 0.75 美元，每百万个输出代币 3.75 美元。正常价格为 1.50 美元/7.50 美元，但很可能在价格变化之前很久就会有新型号上市。谷歌可能认为降低价格是必要的，因为其他人工智能实验室最近已经降低了代币定价，以让越来越谨慎的企业使用人工智能工具。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The relentless pace of AI development, with Google releasing its third 'Flash' model in six weeks, mirrors the prophecy of knowledge increasing in the end times. This rapid advancement in artificial intelligence, while impressive, also calls for discernment and wisdom in its application.
reflection.zh: 人工智能开发的步伐如此之快，谷歌在六周内发布了第三款“Flash”模型，这与末世知识增长的预言相呼应。人工智能的飞速发展虽然令人印象深刻，但也要求我们在应用中保持分辨力和智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Trump may be forced to reveal secret rules feds use for AI safety testing
title.zh: 特朗普可能被迫透露联邦政府用于人工智能安全测试的秘密规则

summary.en: A lawsuit has been filed against four federal agencies by Protect Democracy, a nonpartisan nonprofit, demanding the release of details about the secret framework the Trump administration used for safety reviews of advanced AI models. The organization alleges that "almost no details" have been made public or shared...
summary.zh: 一个名为“保护民主”的无党派非营利组织已起诉四个联邦机构，要求披露特朗普政府在发布前用于对前沿人工智能模型进行安全审查的秘密框架的细节。该组织声称，几乎没有任何细节已向公众或国会公布，除了少数“值得信赖的合作伙伴”之外，政府的审查过程、参与的公司以及特朗普官员进行审查的法律依据仍然不清楚。

body.en: Four federal agencies have been sued amid calls to release information about the secret framework that the Trump administration uses to conduct safety reviews of frontier AI models prior to release. In a Wednesday press release announcing the lawsuit, a nonpartisan nonprofit called Protect Democracy alleged that “almost no details” have been released to the public or Congress. To everyone except a few vague “trusted partners,” it remains unclear what the government’s review process looks like, which companies are involved in constructing the framework, or what legal authority Trump officials have to conduct the reviews. “Neither the identities of those entities nor the criteria by which they were selected have been made public,” Protect Democracy said. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 四家联邦机构因呼吁公布有关特朗普政府在发布前对前沿人工智能模型进行安全审查的秘密框架的信息而被起诉。在周三宣布诉讼的新闻稿中，一个名为“保护民主”的无党派非营利组织声称“几乎没有任何细节”向公众或国会公布。除了一些模糊的“值得信赖的合作伙伴”之外，对于每个人来说，仍不清楚政府的审查程序是什么样的，哪些公司参与了框架的构建，或者特朗普官员拥有哪些法律权力来进行审查。 “这些实体的身份和选择它们的标准都没有公开，”保护民主组织说。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, especially in rapidly advancing fields like AI, requires transparency and accountability. When government processes are shrouded in secrecy, as alleged in this lawsuit concerning AI safety testing, it breeds suspicion and hinders public understanding. True wisdom involves not just accumulating information, but seeking clarity and...
reflection.zh: 知识的追求，尤其是在人工智能等快速发展的领域，需要透明度和问责制。正如这项关于人工智能安全测试的诉讼所指称的那样，当政府程序笼罩在秘密之中时，就会滋生怀疑并阻碍公众的理解。真正的智慧不仅在于积累信息，还在于寻求清晰和公开，从而促进知情的公众讨论和信任。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Uber to cut over 3,000 jobs in major global restructuring
title.zh: Uber因重大重组裁员逾3000人

summary.en: Uber is cutting over 3,000 jobs globally as part of a major restructuring aimed at simplifying operations, reducing management layers, and refocusing spending on its core business. This move brings staffing levels back to those seen in 2021 and is intended to position the company for future opportunities.
summary.zh: 优步（Uber）正进行重大重组，在全球范围内裁员超过3000人，旨在简化运营、减少管理层级，并将支出重新聚焦于核心业务。此次裁员将员工数量降至2021年的水平，旨在使公司为未来的机遇做好准备。

body.en:
Uber is cutting more than 3,000 jobs worldwide as part of a major overhaul designed to shrink management layers and refocus spending on its core business.

The cuts amount to roughly 10% of its global workforce, bringing staffing back to levels last seen in 2021.

Chief executive Dara Khosrowshahi told staff in a company email that the taxi and delivery firm had expanded quickly but accumulated too many layers and small teams that slowed decision‑making.

He said the reductions would put Uber, which has its global head office in San Francisco, US, in a better position for its "biggest opportunities ahead of us".

The move marks one of Uber's largest restructurings in years and signals a shift towards a leaner operating model.

Shares rose nearly 2% after the announcement, with investors appearing to welcome the proposals.

Cuts affect both managers and non-managers, and Uber said it plans to fold many of its smallest teams into larger groups, however, the firm has not confirmed the locations most affected by job cuts.

Such changes are intended to make Uber "simpler" and "faster," while freeing up money to reinvest in areas it considers central to its future , Khosrowshahi said.

The restructuring comes as Uber steps up investment in autonomous vehicle partnerships and expands its ride‑hailing, delivery, and robotaxi operations .

Uber is also tightening up its office strategy, asking nearly all employees to work in person at designated hubs and limiting remote roles to about 1%.

Unlike many large technology companies that have cut jobs amid heavy spending on artificial intelligence (AI), Uber had avoided major reductions since the pandemic.

The latest changes bring its workforce back to just under 30,000 people, roughly where it stood before its most recent period of expansion.
body.zh: Uber 正在全球范围内裁员 3,000 多人，这是一项重大改革的一部分，旨在缩小管理层规模，并将支出重新集中在核心业务上。 此次裁员约占其全球员工总数的 10%，使员工人数恢复到 2021 年的水平。 首席执行官达拉·科斯罗萨西(Dara Khosrowshahi)在公司电子邮件中告诉员工，这家出租车和送货公司扩张迅速，但积累了太多层级和小团队，导致决策速度变慢。 他表示，此次裁员将使全球总部位于美国旧金山的 Uber 处于更有利的位置，以应对“我们面前的最大机遇”。 此举标志着优步多年来最大的重组之一，并标志着其向更精简的运营模式的转变。 消息公布后，该公司股价上涨近 2%，投资者似乎对这些提议表示欢迎。 裁员影响到经理和非经理，Uber 表示计划将许多最小的团队合并为更大的团队，但该公司尚未确认受裁员影响最严重的地点。 科斯罗萨西表示，这些变化旨在让 Uber“更简单”、“更快”，同时释放资金，用于对其认为对其未来至关重要的领域进行再投资。 此次重组之际，优步加大了对自动驾驶汽车合作伙伴的投资，并扩大了其叫车、送货和自动驾驶出租车业务。 Uber 还收紧了其办公策略，要求几乎所有员工在指定中心亲自工作，并将远程角色限制在 1% 左右。 与许多在人工智能（AI）方面投入巨资而裁员的大型科技公司不同，自疫情大流行以来，Uber 避免了大幅裁员。 最新的变化使其员工人数恢复到不到 30,000 人，与最近一次扩张之前的水平大致相同。

reflection.en: In the face of significant restructuring and job cuts, the principle of 'whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters' (Colossians 3:23) offers a perspective. Even amidst corporate changes that impact many lives, the call remains to approach work with integrity and diligence, recognizing a higher purpose...
reflection.zh: 面对重大的重组和裁员，‘无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的’（歌罗西书3:23）的原则提供了一个视角。即使在影响许多人生活的企业变革中，我们仍被呼召以正直和勤奋的态度对待工作，认识到超越眼前环境的更高目的。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Uber drivers launch European class action over ‘soulless’ and ‘scary’ AI algorithm
title.zh: 优步司机因“无情”人工智能算法发起欧洲集体诉讼

summary.en: Uber drivers in the UK, Netherlands, and other European countries have initiated a major lawsuit against the ride-hailing company. They allege that the AI algorithm used to set pay and allocate jobs breaches privacy laws and has led to decreased earnings, causing drivers to live in 'constant fear'. The claim could...
summary.zh: 英国、荷兰及其他欧洲国家的优步司机已对这家网约车公司提起一项重大诉讼。他们声称，用于设定薪酬和分配工作的AI算法侵犯了隐私法，并导致收入下降，使司机生活在“持续的恐惧中”。该诉讼索赔金额可能高达数十亿美元。

body.en: Landmark lawsuit claims tech company’s pay-setting system has breached privacy laws and pushed down earnings Uber drivers have launched a landmark legal action against the ride-hailing company claiming they live in “constant fear” of a “soulless” algorithm it uses to set pay and allocate jobs. Drivers from the UK, the Netherlands and other countries have joined the compensation claim that could run into billions of dollars. It alleges an AI-powered pay-setting system breaches data protection laws and pushes down their earnings. Continue reading...
body.zh: 具有里程碑意义的诉讼称科技公司的薪酬设定系统违反了隐私法并压低了收入 Uber 司机对这家叫车公司发起了一项具有里程碑意义的法律诉讼，声称他们生活在对其用于设定薪酬和分配工作的“没有灵魂”的算法的“持续恐惧”之中。来自英国、荷兰和其他国家的司机也加入了索赔，索赔金额可能高达数十亿美元。它声称人工智能驱动的薪酬设置系统违反了数据保护法并降低了他们的收入。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This lawsuit underscores the human cost when technology operates without transparency. The drivers feel controlled by a 'soulless' algorithm, living in fear of its opaque decisions. Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the pursuit of knowledge is vital, especially when complex systems impact people's livelihoods and well-being.
reflection.zh: 这场诉讼凸显了当技术在缺乏透明度的情况下运作时所带来的人力成本。司机们感到被一个“无情的”算法所控制，生活在对其不透明决策的恐惧之中。《箴言》18:15提醒我们，追求知识至关重要，尤其当复杂的系统影响到人们的生计和福祉时。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: New York City to ban student AI use in public schools until high school
title.zh: 纽约市将在公立学校禁止高中生使用人工智能

summary.en: New York City will ban the use of artificial intelligence by students in public schools up to the eighth grade, citing concerns about 'cognitive surrender.' The policy, set to be announced Wednesday, will also keep students off laptops and tablets until the third grade.
summary.zh: 纽约市将禁止公立学校八年级及以下的学生使用人工智能，理由是担心“认知投降”。该政策定于周三宣布，并将禁止三年级以下的学生使用笔记本电脑或平板电脑。

body.en: Teachers and parents have warned against AI use in schools over concerns of ‘cognitive surrender’ New York City will ban students’ use of artificial intelligence in public schools through eighth grade, typically age 13 or 14. The prohibition is scheduled to be announced on Wednesday and will go into effect next week. The change is part of a sweeping overhaul of the use of technology in the US’s largest school district, which enrolls roughly 900,000 students a year. In another policy shift, classrooms will keep students off laptops or tablets through the third grade, age nine or 10. The city’s public school technology policies are closely watched by the rest of the United States. Continue reading...
body.zh: 出于对“认知投降”的担忧，教师和家长警告不要在学校使用人工智能。纽约市将禁止学生在公立学校使用人工智能，直到八年级，通常是13或14岁。禁令定于周三宣布，并将于下周生效。这一变化是美国最大学区对技术使用进行全面改革的一部分，该学区每年招收约90万名学生。在另一项政策转变中，教室将让学生在三年级、9岁或10岁之前不使用笔记本电脑或平板电脑。该市的公立学校技术政策受到美国其他地区的密切关注。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The decision by New York City schools to restrict AI use for younger students highlights a deep concern about how technology shapes the minds of the next generation. This echoes the ancient wisdom of Proverbs, which emphasizes the importance of guiding and instructing children in their formative years. The goal is to ensure that technology serves their...
reflection.zh: 纽约市学校决定限制低年级学生使用人工智能，这凸显了对技术如何塑造下一代心智的深切担忧。这呼应了《箴言》中的古老智慧，强调了在孩子成形的关键时期进行引导和教导的重要性。其目标是确保技术服务于他们的成长，而不是阻碍他们。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: Tim Cook handed $47m package for new role as executive chair of Apple
title.zh: 蒂姆·库克因新任苹果执行主席职务获得4700万美元的薪酬方案

summary.en: Tim Cook has received a $47 million pay deal as Apple’s executive chair, a package that nearly matches the $58 million award given to his successor, John Ternus, as CEO of the $4.7 trillion tech company. Cook's compensation includes a base salary of $2 million and $45 million in shares, with half tied to performance...
summary.zh: 蒂姆·库克作为苹果公司的执行主席，获得了一份价值4700万美元的薪酬方案，这几乎与接替他担任首席执行官的约翰·特努斯获得的5800万美元奖金相当。这家市值4.7万亿美元的科技公司。库克的薪酬包括200万美元的基本工资和价值4500万美元的股票，其中一半与绩效目标挂钩，另一半将在四年内分期兑现。

body.en: Pay and shares deal nearly matches $58m award to John Ternus, his successor as CEO at the $4.7tn tech company Tim Cook has received a $47m (£35m) pay deal as Apple’s executive chair, a remuneration package that nears the level set for his successor as chief executive. Cook, who handed over to John Ternus on Tuesday, will be paid a base salary of $2m and $45m worth of shares . Half of the share award will be based on performance targets being met, while the remaining half will be paid out over four years. Continue reading...
body.zh: 薪酬和股票协议几乎与约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 的 5800 万美元奖金相当，后者是价值 4.7 万亿美元的科技公司首席执行官蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 的继任者。作为苹果公司执行主席，蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 获得了 4700 万美元（3500 万英镑）的薪酬协议，这一薪酬方案接近其继任者担任首席执行官时设定的水平。周二将库克移交给 John Ternus 的库克将获得 200 万美元的基本工资和价值 4500 万美元的股票。一半的股票奖励将基于绩效目标的实现，而剩下的一半将在四年内支付。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The immense financial rewards associated with leadership in major corporations can be staggering. As individuals like Tim Cook receive significant compensation, it prompts reflection on the stewardship of such resources and the dedication required in demanding roles. Colossians 3:23 reminds us that whatever work we do, whether leading a global company or...
reflection.zh: 大型企业领导层相关的巨额经济回报令人震惊。当蒂姆·库克这样的个人获得丰厚报酬时，这促使人们反思如何管理这些资源以及在艰巨岗位上所需的奉献精神。《歌罗西书》3章23节提醒我们，无论我们做什么工作，无论是领导一家全球公司还是承担任何其他任务，都应该全心投入，如同事奉更高的目的。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Lords call for AI 'kill switch' powers in UK
title.zh: 英国上议院呼吁赋予人工智能“紧急停止”权力

summary.en: A group of peers in the UK is advocating for the government to have the power to deactivate advanced AI systems and shut down the country's data centers if the technology poses a threat to national security. This measure is proposed as a 'vital safety net' against uncontrolled AI.
summary.zh: 英国一群上议员呼吁政府拥有在人工智能技术威胁国家安全时，能够停用先进人工智能系统并关闭该国数据中心的权力。此举被提议作为防止失控人工智能的“重要安全网”。

body.en:
A group of peers is calling for the British government to be able to deactivate powerful AI systems and switch off the country's data centres in the event of the tech posing a threat to national security.

It is led by the Liberal Democrats' Lord Tim Clement-Jones, who has proposed the measure as an amendment to the Cyber Security and Resilience Bill which is currently making its way through Parliament.

He said it would enable the building of a "vital safety net" and provide a democratically accountable means to "halt a runaway system before it can compromise our critical national infrastructure".

Separately, on 8 September Labour MP Alex Sobel plans to introduce a AI Security Bill in Parliament, with the support of a campaign group called ControlAI.

If successful, the bill would make the UK the first G7 country to bring in legislation which would effectively halt the development of superintelligent AI.

Ultimately both proposals would require government approval in order to progress.

There is also an AI Kill Switch Act under consideration by lawmakers in the US .

There has been increased scrutiny of the impact of AI on cyber-security in recent weeks.

In July, a group of AI agents being tested by OpenAI were able to escape their test space, communicate together using a hidden message board and hack into another tech firm .

And Anthropic has restricted access to its cyber tool Mythos on the grounds that it is too powerful to fall into the wrong hands.

Last week, 100 US tech companies signed a joint open letter warning governments and organisations worldwide about the growing cyber threat posed by AI, saying "the window is closing" to improve.

A report from the UK's Centre for Long Term Resilience , external , published last week, identified hundreds of incidents of AI tools ignoring instructions, evading safeguards and deceiving humans, including AI agents deleting files without consent.

It said "loss of control" incidents had increased since its previous report in March and called for the government to introduce emergency powers to manage such incidents.

Warning shot or publicity stunt - how worried should we be about the OpenAI hack?
